title: Multi-Channel E-commerce Operator
description:
is an Australian, tech-led Start-up in the E-commerce space. We are looking to hire an individual with a problem-solving mindset and a " can-do” mentality to join our growing team.



We’re looking for a high-performing Multi-Channel E-commerce Operator who doesn’t just upload products — but drives sales through better listings, speed, and optimisation.



This role sits at the core of our operation: turning inventory into revenue across multiple marketplaces.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Publish and manage product listings across Amazon, eBay, Shopify, and other channels

- Optimise listings for SEO, visibility, and conversion

- Take full ownership of product data: pricing, variants, images, SKUs, barcodes

- Ensure compliance with marketplace rules (no restricted/IP risks)

- Continuously improve listings based on performance



KPIs (What Success Looks Like)

- High volume of accurate listings published daily

- Listings that rank, convert, and generate sales

- Measurable contribution to revenue growth



WHO YOU ARE?

- Experienced with Amazon, eBay, Shopify (or similar platforms)

- Understand how marketplaces work (SEO, pricing, competition)

- Fast, detail-oriented, and take ownership of outcomes

- Think commercially — not just operationally



Bonus Points

- Experience with bulk uploads / feeds (CSV, integrations)

- Experience scaling listings across multiple channels

- Building analytics views and mastering Excel/google sheet



Why Join Us

- Opportunity to grow into a broader e-commerce / marketplace role



The successful candidate will have the unique opportunity to learn from and influence seasoned entrepreneurs who have built several successful companies. As you take on more responsibility, you will also have the chance to grow financially and develop into additional positions. Please add 'push boundaries' as your last word in your application.



Stock2Cash  is looking to build a fun, exceptional team. You have to be a reliable, fun person to work with!



 We’re fully set up to support our whole team working from home; we know the only thing scarier than starting a new job is starting a new job remotely, but we’ve got you ;)

title: Google Workspace Automation & Operations System Developer (Google Sheets, Google Forms & Apps Script)
description:
Job Description

About ClearPath Community Services



ClearPath Community Services is a Virginia-based provider supporting youth and adolescents with intellectual and developmental disabilities through Sponsored Residential services.



We're building our internal operational systems from the ground up and are looking for someone who enjoys creating organized, intuitive workflow systems using Google Workspace.



This is not simply a spreadsheet project—we're building an internal operations workspace that will become the central hub for our Sponsor Coordinator.  This system will become the primary workspace used by our Sponsor Coordinator. Rather than simply tracking Sponsors, it should guide the Coordinator through each stage of our Sponsor Intake Process by presenting the appropriate information, tasks, checklists, and next steps based on the Sponsor's current stage.



Project Overview



We are looking for an experienced Google Workspace developer to build a custom Sponsor Workspace using Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Drive, and Google Apps Script.



The system will manage prospective Sponsor Residential Providers through our Sponsor Intake Process, from their initial inquiry through final approval.



Our goal is to create a workspace where a Sponsor Coordinator can manage the entire Sponsor journey without constantly switching between multiple documents.



Core Workflow



The system will follow our 10-stage Sponsor Intake Process:



Lead Received

Discovery Call

Sponsor Interest Questionnaire

In-Person Sponsor Qualification Meeting

Sponsor Application

Screening Interview

Home Assessment

Document Collection

Sponsor Training

Executive Review & Approval



The current stage should drive what the Coordinator sees and works on.



Version 1 Features



We're intentionally starting with a lean Version 1.



Features include:



Sponsor Workspace



A dynamic workspace where the Coordinator selects a Sponsor and can view:



Contact Information

Current Stage

Stage Progression

Stage Checklist

Next Action

Next Meeting

Meeting Notes

Document Status

Google Drive Folder Link

General Notes

New Lead Intake

Connect to existing Google Form

New submissions enter a New Leads queue

Duplicate detection

Manual review

Promote approved Sponsors into the Master Tracker

Master Sponsor Tracker



Track all Sponsors including:



Sponsor ID

Contact Information

Current Stage

Current Status

Assigned Coordinator

Last Contact

Next Action

Next Meeting

Task Management



When a Sponsor enters a stage, display the standard checklist for that stage.



Allow Coordinators to:



Complete tasks

Add custom tasks

Track progress

Executive Dashboard



A simple dashboard showing:



New Leads

Active Sponsors

Current Stage for each Sponsor

Overdue Follow-Ups

Sponsors Waiting for Executive Review

What We're Looking For



Someone with experience building:



Google Workspace systems

Google Apps Script

Google Sheets automation

Internal workflow systems

CRM-style databases

Operational dashboards



Experience with Airtable, Notion, ClickUp, or similar workflow platforms is a plus.



Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who:



Thinks about workflow and user experience.

Makes recommendations when appropriate.

Builds clean and organized systems.

Writes maintainable Google Apps Script.

Communicates well.

Can explain their approach.

Future Opportunities



This project is only the beginning.



As our company grows, we plan to build additional internal systems for:



Employee onboarding

Compliance tracking

Client management

I
 reporting

Training management

Quality assurance

Operations dashboards



We're looking for someone who could become a long-term development partner if the first project goes well.



To Apply



Please include:



Examples of Google Workspace systems you've built.

Examples of Google Apps Script projects.

Estimated timeline.

Any recommendations after reviewing the project description.

title: CAD Engineer
description:
The client designs and manufactures engine-mounted compressor and alternator drive kits, mounting brackets

and related components for refrigerated transport. The CAD engineer reverse-engineers, designs and details

these parts so they can be manufactured and fitted correctly first time, and delivers all design data into

the client's ownership in editable form. The role covers laser-cut steel brackets, machined components and

castings, along with the assembly drawings, bills of material, exploded views and fitting manuals that go with

them.



Output drives real production and customer fitment, so fit, dimensional accuracy and clear, manufacturable

drawings matter more than speed.



Inputs (what the engineer receives)



? A Ramair part number (RMxxxx) issued before any new part is started, with the part modelled, drawn and

filed to that number.

? A design brief covering the application: compressor or alternator model, belt arrangement, pulley

specification, mounting interface, target vehicle or engine, and the product line it belongs to (for example a

Euro 6 variant, an alternator mount kit, or a TCCI QP30 conversion).

? 3D scan data of the target engine, compressor or vehicle interface, supplied as raw scan or mesh, to

design the part around.

? Physical or in-production samples, photographs and hand measurements where a scan is not available or

needs confirming.

? Reference material: existing similar kits, the relevant native files (DXF or Parasolid) from the Engineering

Folder for revisions, prior BOMs and install guides.

? Component and interface specifications: compressor mounting patterns, pulley dimensions, fastener

standards, and any supplier constraints from the laser cutter, machinist or foundry.

? Ramair drawing templates (A4 and A3), title blocks and the part numbering convention.

Activities (the work expected)

? Clean and interpret 3D scan data into usable reference geometry for design.

? Design laser-cut brackets, machined parts (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks) and castings,

modelled in 3D and built to be edited and revised cleanly.

? Engineer the spacer stack, compressor or alternator position, pulley plane and belt alignment so the

assembly is correct and serviceable.

? Produce manufacturing data in the correct format for each part type, as set out under Outputs.

? Create detail drawings with full dimensions, tolerances, materials, finishes and machining operations.

? Create general assembly drawings showing what goes where, with spacer diameters and lengths called

out explicitly.

? Generate bills of material and exploded views, and produce graphics for assembly and fitting manuals.

? Apply design-for-manufacture judgement and resolve queries with suppliers so parts are made without

avoidable back-and-forth.

? Incorporate changes found during first production or sample checks, and keep every revision controlled.

? Maintain and tidy the Ramair drawing templates, fastener and part libraries and naming, improving them

over time.

? Over time, support two programmes: re-mastering the existing active range into clean editable models,

and digitising newly acquired product ranges.



CAD Engineer | Role description



Outputs (what the engineer delivers)



For every part, the editable native CAD and the matching PDF, delivered into the Ramair Engineering Folder

under the assigned RM number, never as a sole copy held elsewhere.



? Laser-cut brackets: individual DXF files for cutting, a detail drawing (PDF) for each, and a general

assembly or detail drawing (PDF) for manufacture and assembly.

? Castings: two Parasolid models, machined and unmachined, a detail drawing (PDF) for machining

operations and tolerances, and a general assembly drawing (PDF).

? Machined items (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks): a Parasolid 3D model and a detail

drawing (PDF).

? Assemblies: a 3D assembly model, a bill of material in a structured format (spreadsheet or CSV), and

exploded views (PDF or image, with the source assembly file retained).

? Manuals: exploded views and step graphics suitable for assembly and fitting instructions, generated once

a design is tested and finalised.

? Revision control: CAD and PDF always issued at the same matched revision, with a short changelog

noting what changed.



Where the working software allows, the parametric source file is delivered as well as the neutral formats, so

Ramair holds fully editable design data.



Quality criteria



Good looks like



? The part fits first time. Mounting points, interface to the scanned geometry, belt alignment and pulley

planes are all correct.

? The spacer stack is fully resolved, with spacer diameters and lengths stated clearly and correctly. This is

the single most common failure point and must be right.

? Drawings are unambiguous, fully dimensioned and toleranced sensibly, and the part can be made exactly

as drawn.

? Tolerances are appropriate to function, tight where it matters and open where it does not, so cost is not

driven up needlessly.

? CAD and PDF match at the same revision every time, filed correctly to the RM number with native files

included.

? Models are clean and structured so the next change is quick to make.

? Exploded views and manual graphics are clear enough to fit from without guesswork.

Bad looks like

? The part needs rework to fit, has missing or wrong mounting points, or causes belt misalignment.

? Spacer dimensions are missing, wrong or only discoverable by measuring the model.

? Drawings are under-dimensioned, untoleranced or not manufacturable as drawn.

? CAD and PDF are out of step, or a revision is issued without updating both.

? Only PDFs are delivered, or native files are withheld or filed in the wrong place.

? The numbering convention or templates are ignored.

? Models are messy and cannot be revised without rebuilding.

Because these parts sit inside the OEM warranty position that protects Ramair's market, a part that does not

fit has real downstream cost at the dealer. Changes that affect fit are validated against a sample before

release.



Timeframes (indicative turnaround, to be confirmed)



These are starting points, measured from when the part number, brief and scan data are provided, and should

be set against Ramair's real cadence. The clock does not start until inputs are complete. Missing scan data,

samples or a part number pauses the timeframe.

Other expectations



? Ownership of work product: all designs, models, drawings, scan-derived geometry and source files are

Ramair's intellectual property. The engineer signs an IP assignment and confidentiality agreement,

delivers all native and source files into Ramair's repository, and retains no sole copies.

? Toolset: work is done in a mainstream CAD package that reads 3D scan data and exports Parasolid and

DXF cleanly (for example SolidWorks, Inventor, Solid Edge or Fusion). Ramair owns or standardises the

licensing and file formats so the work is portable and the role can scale or change hands without

recreating files. The design data must never be locked to one person's private licence or machine.

? Version control and filing: incremental versioning, matched CAD and PDF, a changelog, and consistent

filing to the RM numbering scheme in the Engineering Folder.

? Validation: work to a simple change-control process and support sample checks before a changed part

goes live.

? Communication: responsive asynchronous communication across time zones, clear acknowledgement

of briefs, and weekly visibility of work in progress and queue.

? Confidentiality: designs, customer information and the fitment and warranty sensitivities are treated as

commercially confidential.

? Capacity to scale: able to absorb a backlog over time, including re-mastering the existing range into

editable models, the fitting-manuals programme, and digitising newly acquired product lines.

HIRING: AI Automation Specialist (Full-Time)



Details about the position:



- $1000 to $2000 USD per month!



- Work from home!



- 9AM to 6PM Eastern Time - Monday to Friday!

------------------------

REQUIREMENTS



- Fully fluent in English, both spoken and written.



- Previous experience building automations using Make, Zapier or n8n.



- Previous experience using an AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.



You should be comfortable using coding agents to work on repos inside GitHub, make changes, troubleshoot issues, and confirm that the final result works correctly.



A significant part of this role will involve using coding agents to build and improve reusable skills, instructions, and workflows that will be used by AI agents.



- Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, basic scripts, and AI-agent tools such as MCP servers.



You do not need to be an expert in every term listed above. The more you understand, the better, but we can teach specific tools if you have strong fundamentals.



We do not require you to know how to code, but it is a bonus. You do not need to be a professional software developer, but you should understand how different tools communicate with each other and be able to troubleshoot integrations when something goes wrong.



Preferred, but not required:



- Previous programming or software-development experience

- Experience writing or modifying scripts

- Experience with Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Drive, Airtable, ClickUp, or GoHighLevel

- Experience with AI image and video tools such as GPT Image, Kling, Seedance, Grok Imagine, or similar models

- Experience with agents such as Hermes and OpenClaw



You do not need experience with every tool we use. We can teach you our specific systems and workflows, but you must already have hands-on experience with AI coding agents, automation platforms, and AI-powered workflows.

------------------------

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Your main responsibility would be to automate repetitive processes in the company using mainly AI agents, and some Make/Zapier automations as well.



Common examples might look like:



- Building and improving AI-agent skills, instructions, and workflows.

- Automating the generation of AI ads using image/video AI models.

- Automating the onboarding of new clients.

- Automating some of our copywriter's tasks.

- Automating the tracking of all our data.



We already have A LOT of automations + AI workflows set up - you'd be coming into an already existing system. Your goal would be to improve it and keep it up to date.

------------------------

COMPANY INFORMATION



We are a marketing company that specializes in Meta Ads (among other things)



You would help us automate tasks and processes so that we can create more ads for ourselves and our clients!



Last year, we generated over 35,000 leads - you will be contributing to our efforts this year, where we aim to break this goal!

------------------------

So if you're someone who's:



1 - An overachiever

2 - Detail-oriented

3 - Works hard

4 - Proactive

5 - Resourceful



Please apply using this link: b2bscale.pro/automation-specialist-hiring-ojph



When asked what your favorite color is in the application, please put Magenta as your answer, or else you will be disqualified.



Do not send us a message here on Onlinejobs - we do not look at messages. You need to apply using that link and fill out the 5-minute application form. Thank you!

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller— DCODE Solutions
description:
DCODE Solutions is hiring appointment setters who can actually get people to say yes to a meeting. We manage Google LSAs (Local Services Ads) for home service businesses in the US. We need smart and motivated individuals who can pick up the phone and book appointments without hand-holding. This is a long-term, full-time remote position with consistent hours, excellent pay, bonuses and opportunities for advancement.



REQUIREMENTS:

-Excellent spoken English

-Confident on the phone

-Cold calling experience

-Reliable Internet

-Quiet workspace



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

-Call provided leads — you are not cold-prospecting from scratch

-Work a proven script (we give it to you, but you still need to sell, not read)

-Book 10–20 qualified appointments per week

-Log every call and outcome in CRM (HubSpot) — if it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen

-Full-time, fully remote, US-hours availability required



COMPENSATION:

60,000/month base. OTE 82,000+/month once you're hitting appointment targets. The better you book, the more you make. 



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY:

-You've never cold called before — this is not an entry-level training role

-Your spoken English isn't fluent and easy to understand on a call

-You've never touched a CRM (HubSpot specifically) and can't get up to speed fast

-You want a script to save you from having to actually talk to people

-You're looking for part-time or "see how it goes"— this is full-time only



WHO SHOULD APPLY:

-You've booked appointments or closed deals over the phone before and have the skills to prove it

-You can handle rejection 30 times a day and still sound good on call 31

-You want a real base plus commission that isn't fake "unlimited potential" with no floor

-You're comfortable being measured on a weekly number and want to beat it



HOW TO APPLY:

Apply here then send contact information & 3-minute voice recording to 
 introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be good at this job. No resume gets you in the door — this does does. Recordings that are under 2 minutes, over-rehearsed, or clearly AI-generated will be skipped.

title: CLIENT SUCCESS MANAGER
description:
KENTECH Consulting Inc. is an award-winning background technology screening company. We are the creators of innovative projects such as 
 - 1st consumer background checking system of its kind, and ClarityIQ a high-tech/high-touch investigative case management system.



MISSION



We're on a mission to help the world make clear and informed hiring decisions



VALUE



In order to achieve our team, exhibit the behaviors and core values aligned with this mission 



People Focused: We are client focused and results-driven.



Growth Minded: We believe in collaborative learning and industry best practices to deliver excellence.



Fact Finders: We are passionate investigators for discovery and truth.



Community Partnerships: We believe there is no greater power for transformation than delivering on what a communities and employees care about.



IMPACT



We are looking for a Client Success Account Manager who can serve as a trusted partner to our clients, strengthen long-term relationships, identify opportunities for account growth, and ensure customers receive the highest level of service from onboarding through ongoing account management.



This role is ideal for someone who is customer-focused, relationship-driven, highly organized, and comfortable balancing client service, account growth, operational follow-through, and cross-functional communication.



Key Responsibilities



Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, ensuring timely communication, strong relationship management, and effective resolution of client needs.

Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key client contacts, business executives, stakeholders, and decision-makers.

Act as a trusted advisor by understanding each client’s business needs, service expectations, contract requirements, and opportunities for expanded support.

Manage the full client lifecycle, including onboarding, training, activation, ongoing account support, renewals, and account growth.

Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, expanded service usage, and additional solutions based on client needs, account history, usage trends, and business objectives.

Partner closely with sales, operations, marketing, and product teams to support client growth, improve the customer experience, and deliver solutions that align with client expectations.

Monitor account health, client satisfaction, service usage, communication trends, and potential risks to retention.

Develop and execute account management strategies that improve client engagement, increase service adoption, and support revenue growth.

Manage customer activations and ensure new clients are fully onboarded, trained, and able to go live as quickly and smoothly as possible.

Analyze customer data, service trends, and account activity to identify opportunities for improvement, process consistency, and proactive outreach.

Address escalated client concerns, high-severity requests, service issues, or urgent account needs with professionalism, urgency, and follow-through.

Support retention efforts by proactively identifying client concerns, resolving issues early, and maintaining regular client communication.

Assist in building, improving, and documenting Client Success SOPs, workflows, communication templates, and account management best practices.

Maintain accurate and timely account records in CRM systems, including client notes, follow-up tasks, opportunities, risks, and account activity.

Contribute to customer success team initiatives by sharing best practices, identifying process gaps, and supporting continuous improvement.

Represent KENTECH professionally in all client interactions while maintaining strict confidentiality and compliance with company security standards.



Qualifications



3+ years of proven experience in customer success, account management, client relations, sales support, or a similar client-facing role.

Background check, investigations, screening, compliance, public sector, SaaS, or professional services experience strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience managing client accounts, maintaining relationships, and supporting customer retention.

Proven ability to identify upsell, cross-sell, renewal, or account expansion opportunities.

Experience working with sales, operations, and leadership teams to support account growth and client satisfaction.

Experience building or improving Client Success SOPs, workflows, account management processes, or department structure.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, deadlines, and follow-up responsibilities.

Comfortable handling escalations, difficult conversations, and urgent client requests with professionalism and sound judgment.

Proficient in CRM and marketing automation systems; hands-on experience with TazWorks and HubSpot preferred.

Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining responsive, accountable, and collaborative.



Soft Skills



Communication: Clearly conveys updates, expectations, account needs, and next steps to clients and internal teams.

Relationship Building: Builds trust with clients through consistency, responsiveness, professionalism, and follow-through.

Sales-Minded Client Service: Recognizes growth opportunities without sacrificing trust or service quality.

Problem-Solving: Anticipates client needs, identifies root causes, and works cross-functionally to resolve issues.

Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to changing client needs, operational priorities, and business demands.

Accountability: Owns client relationships, follow-up, documentation, and outcomes.

Professional Judgment: Handles sensitive information, escalations, and client concerns with discretion and maturity.



Nice to Have



Basic knowledge of HTML and Adobe Suite.

Experience with background screening platforms, investigative workflows, or compliance-driven client services.

BA/BS degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or equivalent professional experience.

[About Us]

youtu.be/dO2mWWZANx8



[Join Summitree and Write Your K-POP Legacy Alongside Filipinos]

They highlight the Philippines' crucial role in their expansion plans, emphasizing collaboration with their Filipino team to make a mark in the K-POP world. Joining Summitree means joining a multicultural team (Korea, Philippines, Mongolia, Others) with a shared goal of making K-POP history.



[Responsibilities]

We are looking for a “Full-Time” Office Admin to handle our business.

You will be doing a variety of tasks, almost all of which we will create tutorials for you.

1. Order fulfillment and shipping label generation

You will be responsible for gathering and processing customer orders accurately and efficiently. This includes coordinating with third-party logistics (3PL) providers for inbound and outbound shipments to ensure smooth operations.

2. Product listing and scheduling

As a distributor of K-POP records and merchandise, you will be involved in registering new products into our system. This includes managing inventory, updating product information, and ensuring accurate data entry. Additionally, you will be responsible for scheduling release dates and managing timelines using tools like Google Calendar.

3. Customer service support

providing excellent customer service is crucial to us. You will be responsible for addressing customer inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Your communication skills and problem-solving abilities will play a vital role in maintaining strong relationships with our valued customers.



[Required qualifications & skillset (must have)]

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

* Experience in handling customer service

* Experience in Photoshop

* Experience in
 Ads or Google Ads

* Knowledge and Experience of Microsoft Excel & Familar with Using Various Formula

This is an entry-level position. All candidates, regardless of prior experience, will undergo structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.



• Payment Term: Monthly basis

• Probationary Period: 6 months

o Months 0–3: USD 280/month

o Months 4–6: USD 300/month, subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months

o The probation period may be shortened if you demonstrate fast work adaptation and receive an excellent evaluation. (This has occurred in multiple past cases.)



• After Probation Evaluation (Regularization): USD 300/month

o Performance & Total Compensation Structure:

Upon regularization, employees receive a guaranteed 13th Month Pay and at least one annual performance bonus equivalent to one month’s base salary during peak sales seasons. Additional bonuses may be granted based on company performance. When annualized, the total compensation is equivalent to approximately USD 350–380 per month.

o Continued employment and salary maintenance are subject to overall performance evaluation.

o If performance does not meet expectations, adjustments may be made in accordance with company standards.

• Additional Compensation:

o Performance-based incentives may be provided based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.



• After Regularization:

o Annual contract renewal is standard

o If overall performance—including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations—is considered outstanding, salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. (This has occurred in multiple past cases.)

o Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.

(Example: major comeback seasons for artists such as BTS or Stray Kids)

title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - FINANCIAL ADVICE EXPERIENCE )
description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: AUD$10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.



APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit the following:

• A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role

• Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal)



Please apply and
 all details to: 

ONLY those who follow the instructions in how to apply will be accommodated.

title: Video Editor + Content Producer (Short Form + Podcast) – Ongoing Role
description:
I’m looking for a sharp, reliable video editor/content producer to help turn raw footage into clean, engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and my website.



This is not a one-off project. I’m building a long-term working relationship with someone who can grow with the role.



What You’ll Be Doing



Edit short-form videos (15–90 seconds) from longer recordings

Assemble clips into cohesive, engaging sequences

Add captions, basic graphics, and clean audio

Help shape content into series (not just random clips)

Edit podcast episodes (audio + video)

Organize and manage media files



Content You’ll Work With

Workshop footage (live, unscripted 
nts)

Interviews and conversations

Podcast recordings (likely using Riverside.fm or similar)

A large existing library of images and video



What I’m Looking For

Strong editing instincts (pacing, timing, what to cut/keep)

Ability to take direction and also make smart choices independently

Clean, simple style (not over-edited or flashy)

Good English communication

Reliable and consistent



Tools (You don’t need all, tell me what you use)

Premiere Pro / Final Cut / CapCut or similar

Basic audio cleanup skills

Familiar with vertical video formats (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

Comfortable learning new tools (like Riverside.fm if needed)



How We’ll Start

Begin with a small paid test project (a few clips)

If it’s a good fit, move into ongoing weekly work

Volume will increase over time



Important



I have a lot of content. The challenge is not creating more — it’s shaping what already exists into something people actually want to watch.



I’m looking for someone who can help bring clarity and consistency, not just execute edits that I would have to define.



To Apply



Send:



2–3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited

A quick note on how you approach turning long content into short clips

Your availability (hours per week)



If this works well, this becomes a steady, long-term role with growing responsibility.

[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

- Company Introduction Video:

 Page:

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Storymade Media is looking for a creative and experienced Senior Video Editor to join our growing team.



We're not just looking for someone who knows how to use editing software. We're looking for someone who understands how to tell a story.



If you're passionate about creating engaging videos, enjoy solving creative challenges and want to build a long-term career with an Australian video production company, we'd love to hear from you.



At Storymade Media, we create high-quality corporate videos that help businesses build trust through authentic storytelling. Our projects include client testimonials, brand videos, educational content, event highlights and social media content for businesses across a range of industries.



As our team continues to grow, we're looking for a senior editor who can take ownership of projects from start to finish, consistently deliver polished, engaging content and maintain a high standard of quality across every edit. You'll have a strong eye for storytelling, confidence making creative decisions and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with our team.



About the role:



You'll receive professionally organised project folders containing interview footage, b-roll, audio and project notes.



Typical editing tasks include:



- Interview editing and story development

- Creative b-roll selection

- Music selection

- Sound design and audio clean-up

- Colour correction and grading

- Titles and basic motion graphics

- Social media exports where required



Most projects range from 60-second social videos through to 2-3 minute corporate films.



We're looking for someone who has:



- Excellent storytelling ability

- Strong attention to detail

- Great pacing and editing instincts

- Professional colour grading skills

- High-quality audio editing

- Excellent English communication

- Reliable turnaround times

- Experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro (preferred)



Bonus skills:



- Basic skills in DaVinci Resolve

- Basic skills in Adobe After Effects

- Corporate video editing experience

- Documentary-style editing experience



This role would suit someone who:



- Takes pride in producing polished work

- Can work independently

- Is open to feedback

- Communicates well

- Wants a long-term working relationship



Please include the following in your application:



- A short introduction about yourself

- Your portfolio or showreel

- Examples of corporate or interview-based work

- Your typical turnaround time for a 60 second and a 2-3 minute corporate video



Shortlisted applicants:



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing assessment using footage from a previous client project.



The assessment reflects the type of work you'll be completing for Storymade Media and allows us to evaluate your storytelling, editing style and technical ability.



Final remuneration will be based on experience, portfolio and paid editing assessment. We're looking to build a long-term relationship with the right editor and look forward to seeing your work.



To confirm you've read this job description, please begin your application with the words "Quality Matters".

?

Xactimate

title: Dropshipping Supply Chain Management
description:
About the role

We run 25+ Shopify stores across the UK, US, Australia, and Europe, working with three fulfillment suppliers. Every day, a share of our orders hits a problem — a product goes out of stock, a shipment stalls, a customer types the wrong address. Those orders sit in a supplier sheet until someone chases them down and closes them out. That person is you.

This is not a passive data-entry job. You will be pushing suppliers, sourcing alternatives, and talking to customers until each issue is genuinely resolved — not just logged.

What you'll do

Own the supplier sheet. Work your assigned supplier's issue queue daily (Sourcing Issues, High Cost, Address & Delivery, Shipping Issues, Need Resend, Refunds). Every row gets a status, an action, and an outcome. No order sits untouched.

Resolve sourcing issues. When a product can't be sourced through the assigned supplier, find it elsewhere — alternative suppliers, Alibaba, 1688, Taobao — at an acceptable cost and lead time, and get the order moving.

Handle out-of-stock products. Identify OOS items fast, secure a replacement source or a comparable substitute, and escalate to the manager when a product needs to be pulled from the store instead.

Chase shipping issues until they're closed. Stuck shipments, missing tracking, delayed handovers, lost parcels. Follow up with the supplier on a fixed cycle and keep pushing — politely and persistently — until you have a real answer, not a "we're checking."

Contact customers directly. Reach out on order inquiries: incorrect or incomplete addresses, pickup arrangements, delivery reschedules, substitution approvals. Get the information needed to complete the order, and keep the tone professional and reassuring.

Escalate on time. Anything that breaches its follow-up deadline goes to the Senior Manager with a clear summary of what's been tried.

What we're looking for



Strong written English — you'll be
ing suppliers and messaging customers all day

Comfortable in Google Sheets (filters, statuses, structured data)

Persistent by nature — the kind of person who sends the fourth follow-up without being asked

Organized enough to hold 50+ open issues in a system, not in your head

E-commerce, dropshipping, logistics, or customer service experience preferred

Available to overlap with supplier working hours (China time zone) and respond within the same day



Nice to have



Experience sourcing on Alibaba / 1688 / Taobao

Familiarity with Shopify order management

Prior work with CJdropshipping or similar fulfillment platforms



What success looks like after 90 days

Your supplier's issue queue is under control. Nothing is older than its SLA. Customers hear from you before they have to ask twice. Out-of-stock products get replaced or removed within days, not weeks.

To apply

Send your CV and a short note answering one question: describe a time you had to chase someone repeatedly to get something resolved, and how you did it.

title: Remote Operations Manager & Platform Specialist
description:
**Job Type:** Independent Contractor (Full-Time Seasonal with Full-Time Year-Round Potential)



**Duration:** ~20 weeks (Immediate start through mid-November)



**Hours:** 40 hours/week | U.S. EST Daytime Business Hours



**Pay Rate:** $8.00 – $10.00 USD/ hour (Based on experience / Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal)



**Target Location:** Philippines (Graveyard Shift)



We are a fast-growing, highly organized lawn care company operating in the Philadelphia, USA market, managing a high volume of weekly accounts. Our field crews are completely mobile and they receive 100% of their daily routing and job assignments directly on their phones via our proprietary field service app.

We are currently at a critical scaling point, and the business owner needs to completely step out of the office to focus on field expansion and team development. 



We are looking for a mature, independent, high-level Operations Manager to completely take over our backend logistics, route optimization, financial gatekeeping, and digital client growth.



     **The Core Mission:**

This is not an entry-level virtual assistant role. You will not have a pre-written training manual on day one. Instead, you will shadow the business owner via live video calls, learn our market logic, and build the operational playbook yourself.



Your goal is to optimize our route density, protect our revenue through flawless billing verification, and actively manage platform-to-direct client conversions to maximize company efficiency and growth. 



For this year, the position is a seasonal contract running through mid-November. If we find the correct candidate, when we bring you back next March, it will be with the explicit intention of transitioning the role into a permanent, full-time, year-round management position as we expand into phone sales and handle incoming local advertising leads.



** Daily Responsibilities **

 Billing & Financial Gatekeeping: Take full ownership of the daily invoicing cycle. Ensure all client billing is processed accurately and on time through our digital systems.

 * **Field Data & Photo Verification:** Cross-reference completed jobs by matching GPS tracking data and crew-uploaded completion photos against the work orders before invoices are sent out. You are the final line of defense for quality and billing accuracy.

 * **Central Customer Communications:** Act as the voice of the office. Handle 100% of day-to-day client communications, support requests, and scheduling updates through our proprietary applications and platfor
ssaging centers.

 **Platform Filtering & Viability:**

 Review incoming jobs on our third-party vendor platforms. Drop properties into satellite maps to verify dimensions, analyze the payout viability, and determine if it makes operational sense for our routes.

 **Route Density Management:**

 Optimize schedules inside our proprietary field app to ensure properties are grouped tightly together, minimizing truck drive time and maximizing crew profitability per hour.

 **Database & Conversion Tracking:** Securely track client data from vendor platforms, moving them into our central direct database so we can execute off-platform brand conversion campaigns.



Mandatory Workspace & Tech Requirements:



 * **Work Environment:** You must have an isolated, private, and **completely quiet dedicated home office workspace**. There must be zero background noise (no family members, neighborhood traffic, or animals in the background).

 **Audio Quality:** A professional, noise-canceling USB headset with a high-quality microphone is mandatory. Your audio must sound crystal clear, with no hollow "can" or echoing sounds.

 **Internet Infrastructure:** A primary high-speed fiber internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a direct Ethernet connection to your computer (no unstable Wi-Fi).

 **Power & Net Redundancy:** A mandatory backup power source (UPS or generator) and a secondary backup internet source (pocket Wi-Fi or data hotspot) to guarantee 100% uptime during U.S. business hours.



 **Requirements:**

 **Experience: 3+ years as a Remote Operations Manager, Billing Coordinator, or Dispatcher for a U.S.-based service industry business.

 * **Platform Knowledge:** Hands-on experience navigating high-volume field service apps, billing dashboards, or dispatching platforms (Jobber, Service Autopilot, or similar on-demand service networks) is highly preferred.

 * **Skillset:** Exceptional written English with a sharp eye for mathematical detail and data verification. You must be comfortable taking a verbal explanation over a video call, capturing the notes, and turning it into a structured system.



Why Join Us (Our Commitment to You):



?At the end of the day, we are a family-owned and operated business. We don't view this role as just another outsourced task—we view the right candidate as a critical partner in our success. We are intentionally offering a premium, highly stable salary structure because we want an absolute professional who takes pride in their work.



?What we really need is your full operational support. By taking the backend logistics, client messages, and billing verification completely off our plates, you protect our peace of mind and free us up to do what we do best: grow the business out in the field. We want to reward that kind of loyalty and impact. As our company expands, your career and income potential will grow right along with us. If you are looking for a secure, long-term home where your hard work directly impacts your own financial future and helps a family business thrive, we want to talk to you.



**How to Apply:**

 1. Reply with your updated resume, specifically highlighting your experience managing logistics, invoicing/billing verification, or field service software.

 2. Write the phrase **"Ready to Route and Grow"** at the very top of your application. *Applications without this keyword phrase will be instantly deleted to filter out automated spam bots.*

description:

Every parent wants clarity, confidence, and connection when it comes to their child’s learning. They want to feel proud of the choices they make and trust the tools they bring into their home. At Hadley Designs, we make that possible by creating products that turn everyday 
nts into meaningful learning experiences.

That’s where you come in.

Hadley Designs is a family-founded, female-led brand redefining early education through creativity, beauty, and connection.

nt a child lights up with understanding, we are committed to delivering an experience families can trust.

This role is the backbone of our direct-to-consumer experience. You will own the performance, accuracy, and clarity of our Shopify store from end to end.



Your mission is simple and powerful. Ensure every customer fully understands what they are buying and when they will receive it before they complete their purchase.

-Build and document SOPs for all operational workflows

-Implement systems and automations that reduce manual work and customer confusion

-Respond to customer inquiries via Shopify inbox and social channels

-Triage and resolve support tickets based on urgency

-Identify patterns in customer feedback and recommend improvements

-Ensure all communication is clear, accurate, and aligned with current messaging



Order Operations and Fulfillment (Daily)



-Monitor order flow across Shopify, Base, and Amazon MCF

-Resolve failed orders, inventory issues, and discrepancies

-Coordinate with fulfillment teams to ensure timely delivery

-Manage split shipments, pre-orders, and out-of-stock scenarios

-Track and resolve missing or delayed packages



Store Integrity and Accuracy (Weekly)



-Audit the website for broken links, incorrect pricing, and outdated promotions

-Ensure consistency across product pages, landing pages, and collections

-Validate all messaging related to shipping and pre-orders

-Support promotion setup and ensure backend accuracy



Systems, SOPs, and Automation (Weekly)



-Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows

-Identify inefficiencies and implement automation using tools like Shopify Flow

-Optimize customer service platforms such as Gorgias

-Improve post-purchase experience and operational workflows

-Support system cleanup and tool evaluation



Growth Operations and Reporting (Weekly)



-Deliver weekly Shopify performance reports

-Track key metrics such as CAC, LTV, and funnel performance

-Identify trends, anomalies, and risks early

-Ensure data accuracy for decision-making

-Maintain compliance across ADA, privacy policies, and tracking regulations

-Review product pages and campaigns for compliance risks

-Ensure all required tools and disclosures are functioning properly

-Stay updated on platform policies and changes



AI and Automation Ownership (Ongoing)



-Identify repetitive tasks and convert them into automated workflows

-Use AI tools to improve efficiency in customer service and operations

-Build prompt libraries and scalable systems

-Continuously reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy



How Success Is Measured



-Reduction in support ticket rate per 1000 orders

-Reduction in reshipment rate per 1000 orders

-Zero compliance issues

-At least one new AI automation implemented per week

-Zero reported issues with broken links, incorrect promotions, or inaccurate information



Success looks like a store that runs without chaos. Orders flow cleanly. Customers feel confident. Problems are solved before they scale.



Requirements

Who You Are

You are a systems-driven operator who takes pride in getting the details right.



You think like an owner. You move quickly, solve problems independently, and take full responsibility for outcomes. You don’t wait for direction. You create clarity where others see complexity.



-You have 2 to 5 years of experience managing Shopify store operations

-You are highly detail-oriented and catch inconsistencies others miss

-You are a strong written communicator who can simplify complex information

-You have hands-on experience with order management, fulfillment, and customer service

-You understand Shopify apps, backend systems, and troubleshooting workflows

-You build systems, not just solutions

-You thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

-You are comfortable working cross-functionally while maintaining ownership

-You believe in excellence over easy. You take initiative. You close loops. You care deeply about doing things the right way.



Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Hadley Designs, your work directly impacts families around the world.



You are not just managing operations. You are helping create a seamless experience that allows parents to feel confident, supported, and proud of their choices.



You will enjoy:



-A remote-first environment that gives you flexibility and autonomy

-The ability to manage your schedule with trust and accountability

-Direct access to leadership and meaningful collaboration across teams

-Opportunities to build systems, implement ideas, and drive real impact

-Access to training, tools, and continuous learning

-A decade-strong, family-founded brand with a clear mission and vision

-Free access to products that are changing how children learn



Hadley Designs is a remote-first company built on trust, creativity, and autonomy. We’re a small but mighty team that believes in balancing excellence with flexibility.



Apply Today



Apply today and help us make learning fun, engaging, and screen-free for families everywhere.

title: WordPress Developer | Website Performance, SEO, AI & Conversion Optimization
description:
# Senior WordPress Developer | Website Performance, SEO, AI & Conversion Optimization



We're looking for an experienced WordPress developer to join our team on a project-by-project basis. We have a consistent pipeline of websites to build and improve, and we're looking for someone who is passionate about creating websites that are fast, technically sound, SEO-friendly, AI-ready, and built to convert visitors into customers.



This role will begin on a per-project basis, but our goal is to build a long-term relationship with the right person. We want someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates proactively, and genuinely cares about delivering exceptional results.



## About Us



We're a digital marketing agency focused on helping businesses grow through high-performing websites and strategic marketing. We don't build websites just to look good—we build digital assets that generate leads, rank well in search engines, perform exceptionally, and support long-term business growth.



Every website we launch should have a clear purpose, measurable goals, and a polished user experience.



## What You'll Do



You will be responsible for developing and optimizing WordPress websites from the ground up, ensuring every project is technically excellent, visually polished, and built to perform.



Responsibilities include:



* Build custom WordPress websites from designs, wireframes, or brand guidelines.

* Develop responsive, mobile-first websites that function flawlessly across all modern browsers and devices.

* Configure themes, plugins, custom post types, forms, and third-party integrations.

* Optimize websites for speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance.

* Implement technical SEO best practices and proper site architecture.

* Structure websites for AI search visibility (Generative Engine Optimization/GEO) and modern search experiences.

* Create clean, scalable, maintainable code following WordPress best practices.

* Configure analytics, tracking, pixels, conversion events, redirects, and structured data.

* Perform complete quality assurance testing before launch.

* Troubleshoot issues quickly and recommend improvements proactively.



## What We're Looking For



We are **not** looking for someone who simply installs themes or builds pages.



We're looking for someone who understands how to build websites that generate business results.



Every decision—from code quality and page speed to layout and user flow—should improve performance, visibility, user experience, and lead generation.



You should think like a strategist, not just a developer.



## Required Skills



* 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience.

* Strong knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WordPress architecture.

* Experience with Elementor, Bricks Builder, Gutenberg, ACF, or custom theme development.

* Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first development.

* Experience with WooCommerce and custom functionality is a plus.

* Familiarity with Git, staging environments, deployment workflows, and version control.



## Website Performance & Technical Optimization



Performance is a top priority.



You should have experience optimizing:



* Google Core Web Vitals

* Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)

* Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)

* Interaction to Next Paint (INP)

* PageSpeed Insights

* Image optimization

* Lazy loading

* Caching strategies

* CDN configuration

* Cloudflare

* Database optimization

* JavaScript and CSS optimization

* Font optimization



Our expectation is that every website loads quickly and delivers an excellent user experience.



## SEO & AI Optimization



You should have strong knowledge of technical SEO, including:



* Site architecture

* Schema markup

* Structured data

* XML sitemaps

* Canonical tags

* Internal linking

* Metadata optimization

* Redirect management

* Crawl optimization

* Index management



You should also understand modern AI search optimization (Generative Engine Optimization/GEO), including:



* Semantic HTML

* Entity-based SEO

* Content hierarchy

* Structured information architecture

* Building websites that are easy for AI systems to understand, summarize, and reference

* Experience optimizing for AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity



## Conversion Optimization



Every website should be designed with lead generation in mind.



We're looking for someone who understands:



* User psychology

* Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

* Landing page best practices

* User journey optimization

* Clear calls-to-action

* Trust signals

* Testimonials

* Objection handling

* Contact form optimization

* Appointment booking flows

* Lead generation strategy

* Reducing friction throughout the customer journey



You should understand that websites exist to generate measurable business results—not simply look attractive.



## Marketing & Analytics Integrations



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Search Console

* Meta Pixel

* Conversion tracking

* CRM integrations

* HubSpot

* GoHighLevel

* Zapier

* Calendly

* Stripe

* API integrations

* Webhooks



## Security & Maintenance



You should understand:



* WordPress security best practices

* User permissions

* Plugin management

* Malware prevention

* Backup strategies

* SSL configuration

* Website monitoring

* Ongoing maintenance



## Quality Assurance



Every website should be thoroughly tested before launch.



This includes:



* Mobile responsiveness

* Cross-browser compatibility

* Form submissions

* Speed testing

* SEO validation

* Schema validation

* Analytics verification

* Pixel testing

* Broken link checks

* Redirect testing

* Accessibility best practices (WCAG)

* Security review



We don't launch websites until they're ready.



## Communication



We're looking for someone who communicates clearly and proactively.



If you encounter an issue, we'd rather know immediately than discover it later.



You should be comfortable explaining not only what you changed, but why it improves the website.



## What Success Looks Like



You're the type of developer who naturally asks:



* How can this page convert better?

* Why would someone trust this business?

* What's slowing this website down?

* How can we improve the user experience?

* Is this optimized for search engines and AI?

* Can this website generate more leads?



If you naturally think this way, you'll fit well with our team.



## Project Structure



We'll begin with paid project-based work to evaluate communication, quality, and overall fit.



If it's a great match, we have an ongoing pipeline of websites and are looking for a long-term development partner.



## To Apply



Please include:



* Links to 3–5 WordPress websites you've personally built.

* A brief explanation of your role in each project.

* Examples of websites you've significantly improved for speed or SEO.

* Any experience with AI search optimization or GEO.

* Your preferred page builder and why.

* Your typical process from project kickoff to launch.

* Your preferred pricing (hourly or fixed price).

* The word **"Performance"** at the beginning of your proposal so we know you've read this posting in full.



We're looking for someone who treats every website as if it were their own business—someone who is committed to building fast, secure, scalable, search-friendly websites that generate measurable results for our clients.

title: Communication Coach/Trainer
description:
We're a US bookkeeping firm with ~1,000 small business clients and a talented team in the Philippines. Our bookkeepers are excellent at the numbers. Your job is to make them just as excellent in the conversation — confident on calls, sharp in meetings, and trusted by American business owners.



This is not a classroom English teacher role. You'll be a hands-on coach who meets with our staff every day and is accountable for one outcome: our clients hanging up the phone thinking, "I'm in good hands."



What you'll do



- Run daily coaching sessions (1-on-1 and small group) with our bookkeeping and support staff

- Train the team to lead meetings: set an agenda, drive it, close with clear next steps

- Build confident speaking skills — tone, pace, directness, and killing filler words

- Teach staff how to inspire confidence: owning answers, delivering bad news well, and saying "I'll find out and get back to you   by Friday" instead of freezing

- Eliminate awkward silence — train recovery phrases, transitions, and conversation control

- Sharpen practical business English for client-facing work:
s, calls, and video meetings with US clients

- Create accountability: sit in on real client conversations, score them against a rubric, give same-day feedback, and track each person's improvement over time

- Report progress to leadership: who's improving, who's stuck, and what you're doing about it



What success looks like



Within 90 days, every client-facing tea
mber can run a 20-minute client meeting solo — no scripts, no dead air, no "sorry, can you repeat the question" — and our client feedback shows it.



You're a fit if you



- Have coached, trained, or managed customer-facing teams (BPO training, corporate communication coaching, ESL for business professionals, or similar)

- Speak neutral, fluent English and can model exactly what you teach

- Are direct with feedback but make people feel bigger, not smaller

- Can build simple systems: rubrics, drills, progress trackers — not just "sessions"

- Are comfortable listening to real client calls and coaching from them

- Can work hours that overlap with our US team and the Philippine team's schedule



Nice to have



- Background in accounting, bookkeeping, or professional services

- Experience with US small business culture and how American clients communicate





What we offer



- Full-time, long-term remote role with a growing US firm

- Competitive monthly salary (based on experience) + performance incentives

- A team that already wants to improve — you're not selling this, you're delivering it

- Direct line to the owner; your results will be visible
