title: Social Media Video Editor
description:
WHAT IS OUTDOORBENGAL



OutdoorBengal exists to help cat parents do more (and better) with their cats. We make adventure cat gear and training tools for the people who think of their cat as family, not furniture. We're a small, profitable, fast-growing team. We sell mostly online (Amazon and our own website), and we're scaling quickly: ~70% growth on Amazon and roughly 10x on our website over the last year.



Right now, we are a small team of 5 people: Neus (product and innovation), Pave (product and innovation, reporting to Neus), Jemar (graphic design), Eliza (customer excellence and demand planning), and Albert (founder, operations, marketing, and most things in between)



Social media is where cat parents discover us. It's also where we teach, entertain, and build trust before anyone ever sees a product page. Today, most of that content is filmed, edited, and posted by Albert, squeezed between everything else a founder does. The result: we post less than we should, and good footage sits unused on hard drives.



That's where you come in.



WHAT IS THE ROLE



You will own the editing and packaging of our social media video content so that we can publish more, better, and more consistently. Over time, as we earn trust together, you'll grow into shaping what we make, not just editing it.



We're looking for one person, long-term, who wants to grow with us. A partner (with ideas, opinions, and willingness to try and fail in the early-stage, hands-dirty sense of the word). Here's how the role grows:



Phase 1 — Foundation (Months 1–6)



In your first six months, your job is to take video content off Albert's plate completely and make it better than he did.



1. Editing short-form video.

You'll turn raw footage (ours and our creators') into Reels, TikToks, and Shorts that stop the scroll. Hooks in the first and second, captions that carry sound-off viewers, pacing that respects a 3-second attention span. You'll learn our brand, our products, and our audience of adventure cat parents and edit like you know them, because you will.



2. Owning the publishing cadence.

At the beginning, we'll share around 100 video ideas you can go off of as we move forward. You'll manage the content calendar, keep a steady pipeline of edited videos ready to go, and make sure we never go dark. Consistency beats brilliance on social, and you'll deliver both.



3. Reading the numbers and iterating.

Every video is a hypothesis. We'll share with you the analytics, and you'll track what performs (hooks, formats, lengths, topics ours and other similar accounts), report on it weekly, and feed what you learn back into the next edit. You don't just make videos; you make each video better than the last because of the one before it.



If you nail Phase 1, you'll have done something rare: you'll have turned our social channels from a founder's side project into a machine. That's the first half of the job.



Phase 2 — Growth (Month 6 onward, conditional on Phase 1)



Once the foundation is solid and trust is established, the role expands into creative ownership:



1. Content strategy — proposing series, formats, and angles; d
 what we film, not just how we cut it.

2. Creator content coordination — working with our ~100-creator affiliate community to source, brief, and repurpose their best footage.



To be clear: Phase 2 is not guaranteed. If you turn out to be an excellent editor but not a strategist, that's fine. We'll figure out together what's next. But we are intentionally hiring someone with the ceiling to do both, and we'll pay accordingly when you grow into it.



WHO YOU ARE



We don't care about your degree. We care that you are:



- Actively working in social media right now. You live on Instagram and TikTok, you know what's trending this week, and you can tell the difference between a format that's rising and one that's already dead.

- Someone who "gets it". You've made videos that went viral. genuinely viral, not "did well for the page." You can show them, and more importantly, you can explain *why* they worked. 

- Ideally, building your own audience. If you have a following on your own Instagram or TikTok, that tells us you don't just execute; you understand the game from the inside. This isn't required, but it moves you to the top of the pile.

- A fast, clean editor. Instagram Edits, CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci... we don't care which. We care that you're quick, your exports are crisp, your captions have no typos, and your pacing is intentional.

- A storyteller with a hook obsession. You know the first second d
 everything. You'd rather re-cut an opening five times than let a good video die on a weak hook.

- Curious and a self-starter with judgment. When a video underperforms, you dig into why. If you don't know what to do, you find out. When something feels off, you flag it. You don't need to be told twice.

- Humble in the truest sense. Willing to learn, willing to admit when you got it wrong. You believe humans never peak, and great work can always be better.

- Long-term oriented. We're not looking for someone for the next six months. We're looking for someone for the next five years. Pave has been with us for 3 years, Jemar for 2. We're building a team and looking for a great teammate.



WHAT'S HELPFUL (Not Required)



- Experience editing for pet, outdoor, or DTC consumer brands.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, TikTok analytics, and YouTube Studio.

- Basic motion graphics or animation skills.

- You like cats. (You'd be surprised how much this helps.)

- ChatGPT/AI literacy. We use it. You should, too. It's as important to master it as it is not to sound like a robot because of it.



WHAT "GOOD" LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS



- We publish edited video content on a consistent cadence, without Albert touching an editing timeline.

- Average video performance is (at least) in line with current.

- You've built a hook/format playbook based on what's working for us and our niche.

- You've documented your own SOPs as you go to make the playbook stronger and reduce guesswork.



If those four things are true at the 90-day mark, we are in business together.



HOW DO WE WORK



- Remote and async-friendly. You set your own hours within reason. We don't micromanage your day.

- Hubstaff for hours and accountability. We use Hubstaff to track working hours and take periodic screen recordings while you're on the clock. We're upfront about this because we'd rather you know than feel watched. In practice, we rarely review the recordings. They exist as a baseline of trust and a paper trail, not as a surveillance tool. You log your hours; we pay against them.

- Direct feedback, both ways. We tell you when something's off; we want you to tell us the same. The fastest way to lose trust here is to tell us what we want to hear.

- Long-term win-win. We want you to grow. We want you to be paid well. We want you to be here in five years. If any of that stops being true on either side, we talk about it openly.

- Tools you'll use regularly: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, your editing software of choice, Asana, WhatsApp, and Hubstaff.



COMPENSATION



We pay well for the right person. We will tell you specifically what we're offering once we know who you are and what you bring, but the range is competitive for the role and the trajectory, and it grows as your scope grows. If trajectory + money + meaning is your filter, let's talk.



HOW TO APPLY TO THIS POSITION



Send an
 to 
 with:



- A short note (3–5 paragraphs, not a cover letter template) telling us who you are, why this role caught your attention, and what you'd want to be doing in three years if this works out.

- A link to your TikTok/Instagram and/or portfolio.

- Proof you understand social media. This is the heart of the application:

  1. Go to our 
 one Reel that did NOT reach 100K views. Tell us 1 or 2 specific things that would have made that video perform better. Be concrete. A "better hook" isn't an answer; share the new script, or what opening shot should we've used, or where to trim or expand...

  2. Share your best-performing video ever (link or file) and explain why it worked. Not what it's about *why it worked*.



We read every application. We only respond to applications that have "Social Media Video Editor - btw, I love your cat" as the
 subject.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



We don't hire from interviews alone. Here's how we choose:



- Application review. We read your
, your reel critique, and your video breakdown. If we like what we see, we move you to the next round.

- Paid task. Shortlisted candidates receive raw footage from us and edit one short-form video, exactly as they would on the job. We pay for your time whether or not we move forward together.

- Interview. A conversation with Albert. We'll talk about your edit, your background, and how you think about content.

- Decision. The combination of how you handled the task and how you showed up in the interview is what determines the hire.



Expect the full process to take 2–3 weeks from application to offer.



I can't wait to meet you.



— Albert

OutdoorBengal

title: Video Editor + Clipper (YouTube Long-Form + Short-Form Social, Full Stack) - Remote, Long-Term
description:
Read this first

This is not an entry-level role. We are not looking for someone who followed a "learn CapCut in a weekend" tutorial and cut a few travel Reels for fun. We are looking for a senior editor who has cut full YouTube videos AND short-form clips at volume, for a real brand or creator, on a real schedule, with a portfolio that proves it.



If your reel is mostly wedding videos, gaming montages, or one client you edited a year ago, stop reading. The tests will expose it in an hour. If you can't send links to long-form videos AND clips you personally cut that are live right now, this isn't your post.



You will not shoot anything. We provide all the footage (talking-head recordings, screen recordings, B-roll, podcast files). Your job is to turn raw footage into finished YouTube videos and a steady stream of clips for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok.



About RMD

RMD is a digital marketing agency. Our team is distributed across Morocco and Dubai and works remote. Our primary client base is in Dubai and the GCC, with growing work across the EU and North Africa. We run SEO, paid ads, branding, and web development for service businesses, e-commerce stores, and B2B companies in 20+ countries. We are now building our own content engine (YouTube + social) and, as it grows, the same engine for clients.



What this role is

You own the edit end to end. Two lanes, both equally important:



Long-form (YouTube): full videos from raw footage. Story cut, pacing, B-roll, sound cleanup, music, captions, motion graphics, thumbnail-ready frames. A finished video someone watches to the end, not a rough assembly.

Short-form (clips): cutting the best 
nts out of long footage and podcasts into Reels, Shorts, and TikToks. Vertical reframing, punchy hooks in the first 2 seconds, animated captions, on-trend pacing, retention-first.

We hand you the footage and the brief. You hand back finished, upload-ready files on schedule. If you only want to do "creative director" work and hand the timeline to someone else, this role isn't a fit. The edit IS the role.



What you'll do

Edit full YouTube videos from raw talking-head, screen, and B-roll footage: story-first cut, tight pacing, jump-cut cleanup, remove filler and dead air, color and audio correction, music and SFX, lower-thirds and simple motion graphics

Cut short-form clips from long videos and podcasts: find the 
nt that earns the click, reframe to vertical, hook the first 2 seconds, animated captions, retention pacing

Write or refine on-screen captions and text so they read like a human, not an auto-generate button (we work in English and French; French text must keep its accents, we can supply the copy)

Design or set up upload-ready thumbnail frames and export in the right specs per platform (YouTube 16:9, Reels/Shorts/TikTok 9:16)

Manage your own file pipeline: pull raw footage from our drive, organize projects, name and deliver exports cleanly, hit deadlines without being chased

Turn one long video into a batch of assets (1 long-form + multiple clips) so every piece of footage gets maximum output

Iterate on feedback fast: take notes in writing, apply them, deliver v2 without re-explaining

Use AI tools (Descript, ChatGPT, Claude) as part of the daily workflow. AI is openly used in the agency, not as a shortcut to skip thinking

Communicate with the team in writing daily (ClickUp,
). Updates short, blockers raised early

Required (we will verify all of this)

3+ years editing video professionally. For a brand, an agency, or a creator with a real audience. Not "I edit as a hobby". You ran the edit on a real schedule.

A portfolio with BOTH lanes. Links to (a) full YouTube videos you personally cut and (b) short-form clips you personally cut, both live now. If it's under NDA, show what you can and be ready to walk us through your exact role. "I helped with editing" is not a portfolio.

Proficiency in a professional editor. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or (for short-form) CapCut. You know your chosen tool's timeline, keyframes, color tools, and audio tools without a tutorial. Tell us which one you own and prove it in the portfolio.

Descript in production. You have used Descript for real editing (transcript-based cuts, filler-word removal, captions, or Studio Sound), not just opened it once.

Motion graphics beyond the basics (After Effects, animated intros, kinetic typography)

Sound design and mixing at a high level

French (we have France and North Africa clients and content)

Experience editing for a channel that grew, and you can point to your part in it

Podcast editing (multi-cam, multi-track audio)

People who ship the work and don't disappear

People who want a long-term role, not a gig

People who can take direction in writing, push back when they think we're wrong, and own a deliverable end to end

People who can show their work, not just describe it

Direct work with the CEO and a small team. Your edits ship for real in week one

Performance bonus structure discussed after the first month

Async-first culture. If you do the work, you'll be left to do it

 with the subject:

, include:

title: Operations & Project Execution (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. 



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” 

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” 

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Business Ghostwriter and Substantive Editor
description:
I am looking for an exceptional writer and substantive editor to help turn my ideas, frameworks, transcripts, and (most importantly) AI-assisted drafts into thoughtful, natural, engaging content for successful business owners.



This is not a proofreading position.



I am not looking for someone who simply corrects grammar, replaces a few words, or makes minor improvements to an existing draft. I need someone who is comfortable substantially rewriting content so it sounds like it was written by a thoughtful, experienced human rather than generated by AI.



The right person will be part editor, part ghostwriter, and part thinking partner.



You will receive strong source material, including:



* Complete ebook and article drafts

* Original frameworks and intellectual property

* YouTube transcripts

* Voice recordings

* Rough notes and outlines

* Examples of my natural speaking and writing style



Your job will be to turn that material into content that sounds clear, conversational, intelligent, specific, and genuinely human.



The content is written primarily for successful business owners between approximately 50 and 70 years old.



The writing should feel sophisticated enough for a successful founder but simple and conversational enough to be enjoyable to read



Your responsibilities may include:



* Substantially rewriting AI-assisted ebook chapters

* Turning rough ideas into polished long-form content

* Rewriting generic passages to make them specific and memorable

* Adding fictional founder examples and realistic scenarios

* Improving openings, transitions, pacing, and conclusions

* Removing repetition and unnecessary explanation

* Making financial and business concepts easier to understand

* Identifying sections that are weak, obvious, or underdeveloped

* Capturing my natural voice from recordings and transcripts

* Editing YouTube scripts, newsletters, articles, guides, and other content

* Maintaining consistency across longer manuscripts



You will have permission to change every sentence when necessary.



The objective is not to preserve as much of the original draft as possible. The objective is to produce the strongest finished piece.

The finished content should have:



* Natural variation in sentence length

* Concrete examples rather than generic statements

* Strong opinions and useful judgment

* Realistic founder concerns and tradeoffs

* Warmth without unnecessary sentimentality

* Authority without sounding academic

* Simple language without sounding simplistic

* Occasional personality and humor when appropriate

* Smooth transitions rather than formulaic headings

* Emotional insight grounded in real situations



The writing should not include:



* Obvious AI phrasing

* Repetitive summaries

* Unnecessary rhetorical questions

* Perfectly symmetrical lists in every section

* Generic motivational language

* Excessive use of words such as “navigate,” “journey,” “landscape,” “unlock,” or “transformative”

* Paragraphs that merely repeat the previous paragraph

* Surface-level word substitutions presented as editing



You must have excellent written English and a strong understanding of natural American business communication.



I am not looking for a general virtual assistant who also performs writing tasks. I am looking for someone whose primary professional strength is writing and editing.



Selected candidates will be offered a paid test.



The test will involve rewriting approximately ~1,000 words from an existing ebook chapter. The payment for the test will be $100 USD.



This is not a proofreading test.



You are encouraged to:



* Rewrite complete paragraphs

* Reorganize the section

* Remove weak material

* Add a fictional example

* Improve the voice and pacing

* Make the material more specific and engaging



You will submit:



1. A clean rewritten version

2. A version showing your changes

3. A short explanation of the most important editorial decisions you made



Candidates who perform well may be hired for the complete e-book and ongoing content work.

title: Customer Service & Community Manager
description:
Part-Time Customer Service & Community Manager — Swimwear Brand (Long-Term)



Job Type: Part-time (approx. 20 hours/week)

Salary: 500 USD per month based on 20 hours per week ($6 per hour)

Schedule: 4 hours per day during business hours AEST, Monday - Friday





About Us



We're Fearless Swimwear — an Australian e-commerce swimwear brand built on making women feel confident and comfortable in their bodies. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and the way we talk to them matters: friendly, casual, empathetic, empowering, and real. We're a small, close-knit team, and we're looking for someone who genuinely cares about people to be the voice our customers hear.



This is a long-term role for the right person. If you love helping people, take pride in a tidy inbox, and want to grow with a brand that treats its team well — we'd love to meet you.





What You'll Do



Customer Success & Experience





Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries via
, chat, and social media, ensuring timely, warm, and solution-focused responses.

Uphold the Fearless brand voice — friendly, casual, empathetic, empowering, and real — in all customer communications.

Manage returns, exchanges, and fit-related queries in line with Fearless policies, ensuring customers feel supported and satisfied.

Anticipate and identify recurring issues or customer pain points, and proactively suggest process improvements.

Maintain a positive, customer-first approach even in challenging interactions, using empathy and professionalism to de-escalate where needed.

Monitor post-purchase satisfaction and gather testimonials, reviews, and fit feedback to improve future experiences.





Operational & Administrative Support





Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in customer support tools and systems.

Monitor inventory-related inquiries and liaise with the operations team to resolve stock or fulfillment issues.

Track and report key customer service metrics (response time, satisfaction rate, common issues) to leadership.

Support launches, campaigns, or special projects requiring customer communication and feedback coordination.







What We're Looking For





Excellent written English — clear, warm, and natural. This is the #1 requirement. You'll be the voice of our brand.

Previous customer service experience, ideally for an e-commerce, retail, or DTC brand.

A genuine, empathetic communicator who can stay calm, kind, and professional — even with a frustrated customer.

Organised and reliable — you follow up, you keep records tidy, and things don't slip through the cracks.

Proactive problem-solver who spots patterns and suggests better ways of doing things, rather than just clearing tickets.

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision, and communicating clearly with a remote team.

Stable internet connection and a quiet space to work.





Tools You'll Use (experience is a big plus)





Re:amaze (or similar helpdesk — Gorgias, Zendesk, Gladly, etc.)

Shopify — order lookups, returns, exchanges, refunds 

Instagram / social media DMs & comments

Gmail & Slack for communication and internal coordination







Why You'll Like Working With Us





A supportive, friendly team that values you as a person, not just a worker.

Long-term, stable role with room to grow as the brand grows.

Meaningful work for a brand with a mission you can feel good about.

Clear processes and a leader who communicates well and respects your time.







How to Apply



Please don't send a generic application — we read every one. To apply:



Start your reply with the word "CONFIDENT" so we know you read this whole post.



Briefly tell us about your customer service experience, especially any e-commerce or fashion/retail brands.



Tell us which of the tools above you've used (Re:amaze, Shopify, Instagram, Gmail, Slack).



Answer this: A customer messages angrily because the swimsuit she ordered for a holiday hasn't arrived and she leaves in 3 days. Write the reply you'd send her — in your own words.



We're genuinely excited to find the right person. 



Applications that follow the steps above go straight to the top of our list.

title: Content & Creative Specialist — Luxury Vacation Rental Brand | Reels, Ads, Email & PR
description:
We’re Penrose Collective, a luxury hospitality company managing a portfolio of stunning short-term rental properties across the US — including a 7-bedroom estate and micro-wedding venue in Texas, a boutique cabin in the Catskills (NY), and more properties launching soon. We attract guests through direct bookings, Airbnb, and Google — and we need one creative person who can own ALL our visual content, from viral Reels to
 flyers to paid ad creatives.



This is not just a video editing role. You’ll be our one-person creative studio.



What You’ll Be Doing



Video Content (~60% of your time)

• Receiving raw video footage of our properties (interiors, exteriors, weddings, guest experiences, drone shots, behind-the-scenes) via Google Drive

• Independently researching trending formats, hooks, audio, and editing styles across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Editing and producing 2–3 short-form videos per day (30–90 seconds each) — property tours, wedding content, before/afters, seasonal edits, POV walkthroughs, trend adaptations

• Using AI tools (CapCut AI, Runway, Opus Clip, ElevenLabs, Pika, etc.) to enhance quality and speed

• Writing scroll-stopping hooks, captions, and CTAs for each video

• Adapting each edit for cross-platform posting (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Pinterest)



 Flyers & Marketing Collateral (~20% of your time)

• Designing
 flyers and newsletters for leads who come in through our website — these need to look premium, on-brand, and drive bookings

• Creating seasonal promo
s (holiday weekends, wedding season, retreat packages)

• Building
 templates in Canva that we can reuse and customize for different properties and offers

• Maintaining consistent brand aesthetic across all
 touchpoints (our brand palette is warm, luxury, earthy — think Poppy Orange tones, clean fonts, editorial feel)



Ad Creatives & Graphic Design (~15% of your time)

• Designing static and carousel ad creatives for Google Ads,
/Instagram Ads, and Pinterest Ads

• Creating social media graphics — Instagram carousels, Stories, Pinterest pins,
 event covers

• Building Canva templates for recurring content types (testimonials, pricing highlights, property features, FAQ graphics)

• Writing short ad copy and headlines for paid campaigns — punchy, benefit-driven, conversion-focused

• Designing one-pagers, lookbooks, or PDF guides when needed (e.g., “Your Wedding Weekend at Penrose House” guide for leads)



PR & Brand Presence (~5% of your time)

• Researching and compiling media opportunities — travel blogs, wedding publications, lifestyle press, and STR/hospitality industry features that are a fit for our properties

• Drafting outreach
s to journalists, bloggers, and editors pitching Penrose Collective stories (property launches, unique guest experiences, design features, wedding offerings)

• Monitoring brand mentions across Google, social media, and review platforms and flagging anything worth responding to or amplifying

• Sourcing and coordinating gifted stay or press trip opportunities with travel influencers and content creators

• Maintaining a running PR tracker (target outlets, contact info, pitch status, follow-up dates)

• Supporting award or editorial submission opportunities (e.g., “Best Wedding Venues in Texas,” travel listicles, hospitality features)



What We’re Looking For



Must-Haves:

• 1+ year of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Strong proficiency in CapCut Pro (required) — Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is a bonus

• Advanced Canva skills — you can design polished flyers,
 layouts, ad creatives, and social graphics quickly

• Deep understanding of what makes short-form content go viral — hooks, pacing, retention, trending audio

• Ability to write clean, persuasive ad copy and
 copy in English — not just edit visuals

• Eye for luxury/premium brand aesthetics — your designs should feel high-end, not templated

• Basic color grading and audio mixing skills for video

• Reliable internet and a machine that handles 1080p/4K footage

• Available 40 hours/week, Philippine time (flexible on exact hours)

• Self-starter who pitches ideas, not someone who waits to be told what to do



Strong Bonuses:

• Experience with AI tools (Runway, Pika, HeyGen, Opus Clip, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT for copy)

• Background creating content for hospitality, travel, wedding, real estate, or lifestyle brands

• Experience with
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Flodesk, or similar)

• Understanding of Google Ads / Meta Ads creative best practices

• Experience designing PDF lookbooks, pricing guides, or event packages

• Familiarity with Pinterest content strategy

• Experience growing a brand’s social following organically

• Prior PR, media outreach, or influencer coordination experience — even informal (running your own blog, pitching brands, managing collab partnerships)



How to Apply

To be considered, please send the following:



	1.	A short intro about yourself and why this role is a fit

	2.	2–3 video edits you’ve done (links preferred — Google Drive, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

	3.	2–3 graphic design samples (Canva work, ad creatives,
 flyers, or social graphics)

	4.	Your availability and expected monthly rate



Applications without samples will not be reviewed. We move fast — if it’s a fit, you’ll hear from us within a few days.

title: Technical Support Team Lead (Growth Role) - Streaming
description:
We promote our leads from inside the work. You'll spend your first months in the queue alongside the team — learning our products, our customers, and where the real problems live — and grow into running support from there. It's how we make sure our lead is someone the team actually trusts.



We're a Canadian streaming TV company — not a BPO. You'll work directly with the owner and a team of six.



Hours: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday. You'll work an 8-hour shift within our 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM Pacific Time coverage window. Your exact shift is agreed with you at offer stage.



Extra hours: Optional and paid. Some of our team pick up a 6th day or additional shifts. If you want more hours, they're available. If you don't, 40 is 40.



Pay: $1500 CAD/month to start, based on experience. Formal performance review at 6 months, with a path into the lead role.

Getting started:



Handle escalated tickets and calls — Android boxes, Firesticks, smart TVs, apps, buffering, playback and login issues

Become the person the rest of the team brings the hard ones to

Fix recurring problems at the root, not just ticket by ticket

Write the troubleshooting documentation we're missing



Growing into:



Owning the support queue and its quality

Coaching the team, reviewing calls and tickets, running the daily handoff



You're a fit if you have:



5+ years technical support with real customers — phone and ticket, not chat scripts

Prior experience leading, coaching, or mentoring a support team

Deep familiarity with streaming devices and apps. You've troubleshot a buffering Android box on a bad ISP connection and you know where to start

Clear, calm English, written and spoken

Experience with a ticketing system (we use Freshdesk) and a phone system

Enough judgment to make a call on your own, and enough sense to know when to ask



We offer: Performance Bonuses, Vacation Time and Paid on time, every time.

To apply: Start your message with the word ROUTER. Then answer in your own words — no AI-generated answers, we can tell:



You've led or mentored a support team before. This role starts in the queue and grows into leading. What appeals to you about that path right now?



Describe the hardest technical issue you've solved for a customer. What was the actual root cause?

A customer says "it worked yesterday, now it's frozen." What are your first three questions?



Applications without the keyword won't be read.

title: U.S. Tax Support & Personal Support
description:
Virtual Executive Assistant – U.S. Tax, Operations & Personal Support (10+ hrs/week)

Long-Term | Remote | Flexible Hours | Opportunity to Grow Into Full-Time

***Important Note: This role requires high-quality, human-standard work. No “AI slop,” auto-generated templates, or generic outputs.***



About the Role

I am seeking a highly reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to support a growing U.S.-based tax and accounting firm. This position requires genuine human judgment, clear communication, and thoughtful execution—not automated or copy-pasted responses.



You will work directly with the owner, who operates the firm during evenings and weekends while maintaining a full-time job. The firm is boutique and specialized, which means accuracy, professionalism, and discretion are essential. This role may grow into a full-time position as the firm expands. We primarily provide tax guidance to Airbnb hosts, but have a handful of other small business clients.



Key Responsibilities



1. Tax & Accounting Administrative Support

- Assist with U.S. federal and state tax preparation workflows.

- Maintain calendars for all weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual filing obligations.

- Set up new clients in our CRM, billing systems, QuickBooks, and document management platforms.

- Handle billing, invoicing, and payment follow-ups.

- Maintain QuickBooks to firm standards (accurate categorization, reconciliations, vendor/client updates).

- Assist with financial analysis for rental properties/Airbnbs.

- Work must be precise and manually reviewed—no AI auto-generated forms or tax outputs.



2.
 & Task Management

- Manually review and filter the owner’s
 daily.

- Identify tasks, draft clear and personalized responses, and maintain an organized task list.

- No automated or AI-generated
 replies—each message should be personalized and situationally aware.

- Support digital organization and document structuring.



3. Client Communication

- Communicate professionally and personally with clients regarding documentation, scheduling, and follow-up needs.

- Use judgment and situational awareness; no template-sounding messages or AI-influenced tone.

- Represent the firm with a warm, human, trustworthy presence.



4. Marketing & Content Support

- Assist with simple monthly blog posts, flyers, print materials, and light content editing.

- Help coordinate with the company’s website developer.

- Maintain inbound inquiry inboxes.

- Content should be original, thoughtful, and aligned with the firm’s voice—no AI-generated marketing fluff.



5. Personal Support

- Handle personal travel bookings, reservations, and scheduling.

- Maintain the owner’s personal Quicken budgeting.

- Support a private project requiring discretion.

- Assist with personal to-do lists and general life management.

- All work must reflect careful thinking and sound judgment.



6. Process Building (When Hours Are Available)

- Create SOPs, templates, checklists, and internal documentation based on real workflows.

- Build systems with clarity and logic—not AI auto-written filler or generic boilerplate.



Qualifications

- Experience with U.S. tax preparation or tax admin REQUIRED.

- Expertise in QuickBooks; familiarity with Quicken preferred.

- Excellent written and verbal English; ability to write naturally without “AI tone.”

- Strong organizational skills and an independent, detail-oriented work style.

- High integrity and ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

- Experience supporting small businesses or accounting firms is ideal.

- Experience with Canva or Google Workspace is beneficial.



Workload & Hours

- Approximately 10 hours per week.

- Flexible around evenings and weekends.

- Potential to grow into a full-time role with expanded duties.



Compensation

- Competitive hourly rate depending on experience.

- Weekly payments.

- Long-term partnership preferred.



Personality & Work Style

Looking for someone who:

- Produces real, thoughtful work (NO AI-generated slop).

- Writes clearly, concisely, and naturally.

- Is proactive, dependable, and self-directed.

- Has excellent judgment and care for detail.

- Is loyal, discreet, and genuinely invested in helping the business grow.



How to Apply

Please include:

1. A brief introduction—written by you, not AI.

2. Real examples of work related to U.S. tax admin, QuickBooks, or client communication.

3. Your weekly availability.

4. Your ideal hourly rate.

title: Copywriter (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
We're a creator management agency. We build personal brands for independent creators and we write everything they publish — from their profile bios to the messages that go out to their audience.



Every creator is a different person with a different voice. Your job is to write as them, not about them.



What you'll write

* Profile bios and about-sections — positioning, hook and personality in two or three lines

* Social captions that make people stop, feel something, and act

* Promotional copy and audience messages

* Re-engagement messages that bring back followers who've gone quiet

* Voice guides that define each creator's persona so the rest of the team stays on-voice



What we need

* C2 / near-native English. Rhythm, humour, slang, the deliberate typo. If your writing reads as "translated well," this isn't the role.

* Extreme creativity. Not "solid ideas." We mean the person who writes the tenth caption for the same photo and it's the best one. If you get bored of your own writing, you're the right kind of writer.

* The ability to inhabit another person. You can read a creator's story, look at how she talks, and think from inside her head — her humour, her insecurities, what she'd never say. Empathy is the actual core skill here. Everything else is technique.

* Range. You can move from playful and chaotic to dry and understated in the same afternoon, and both sound like real people — not like the same writer wearing a hat.

* Persuasion, not decoration. Every line has a job: click, reply, act, come back. You write to move people, not to sound clever.

* Social media instinct. You understand hooks, short-form attention, and why one caption gets 40 comments and the next gets four.

* Speed. This is high volume. Eight captions is an hour, not an afternoon.



What we're not looking for

* Portfolios built on SEO blogs, B2B whitepapers and LinkedIn thought leadership. Different craft.

* Anyone whose plan is to run it all through AI. We use AI too — as a tool, not as a voice. We can tell.



What we offer

* Fully remote — work from home

* Weekly salary, paid on time, every week without exception

* A stable long-term position with real growth opportunities (Team Lead, Senior Copywriter)

* Performance bonuses for outstanding results

* A supportive team environment



How to apply



We pay above market for people who are actually good. 
 on
 with:

1. Your CV.

2. Your copywriting experience — which niches you've written for, and how long you've been doing it.

3. Why you. Four or five sentences on why we should hire you and not someone else. Don't be modest and don't be generic.

4. Your rate and your availability.

5. End your message with: COPYWRITER 2026



No cover letters. We'll know from how you write the message itself.

title: PROPERTY MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR - BUILDIUM EXPERT REQUIRED
description:
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR - BUILDIUM EXPERT REQUIRED



Pacific Homefront Property Management is a growing California-based property management company looking for an experienced Property Management Accounting & Operations Coordinator to join our team long-term.



PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING.



This is NOT an entry-level Virtual Assistant position and this is NOT a basic administrative role.



We are specifically looking for someone with strong property management accounting and bookkeeping experience who has extensive hands-on knowledge of Buildium.



The ideal candidate is extremely detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and capable of helping management maintain control over daily operations.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



-Manage property accounting and bookkeeping processes within Buildium



-Assist with monthly bank and trust account reconciliations



-Review financial records, transactions, owner ledgers, tenant ledgers, and accounting entries for accuracy



-Identify discrepancies, missing transactions, incorrect entries, and accounting errors



-Assist with owner statements, vendor bills, payments, and financial reporting



-Maintain accurate and organized financial records



-Monitor Buildium for incomplete tasks, missing documentation, outstanding balances, and operational discrepancies



-Develop and maintain daily and weekly task lists based on company priorities



-Track the status of open tasks and follow up until completion



-Help delegate and coordinate tasks with other tea
mbers



-Perform quality control reviews to ensure tasks are completed correctly and not simply marked complete



-Communicate professionally with tenants, vendors, owners, and tea
mbers by phone and



-Identify operational problems and propose practical solutions



-Help improve workflows, checklists, SOPs, and internal systems as the company grows



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We need someone who naturally notices when something does not look right.



If a ledger is incorrect, we expect you to investigate it.



If a task is overdue, we expect you to notice it and follow up.



If a process repeatedly creates errors, we expect you to identify the pattern and recommend a better process.



If another tea
mber forgets an important task, we need someone who can catch the issue, help correct it, and develop a system to reduce the likelihood of it happening again.



We are NOT looking for someone who waits every morning to be told what to do.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



-Extensive hands-on experience using Buildium



-Property management accounting or bookkeeping experience



-Experience completing or assisting with bank and trust account reconciliations



-Strong understanding of tenant ledgers, owner ledgers, income, expenses, bills, payments, and financial records



-Experience reviewing financial data for accuracy and discrepancies



-Strong written and spoken English



-Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based tenants and vendors by phone



-Strong attention to detail



-Ability to prioritize tasks independently



-Experience tracking multiple open items and following them through completion



-Ability to work during California business hours



LEADERSHIP AND OPERATIONS EXPECTATIONS



This position will work closely with company management and will eventually serve as a delegating and quality-control arm of the operations team.



You may be responsible for helping organize the daily workload of another Virtual Assistant, monitoring task completion, following up on outstanding items, and identifying quality-control concerns.



You must be comfortable providing respectful feedback, holding others accountable, and helping create systems that improve team performance.



Leadership opportunities will be earned through accuracy, reliability, initiative, judgment, and consistent performance.



DO NOT APPLY IF



-You have never used Buildium in an actual property management company



-You only have basic data-entry experience in Buildium



-You do not have bookkeeping or property accounting experience



-You have never worked with reconciliations



-You are uncomfortable speaking English on the phone



-You need detailed instructions before starting every task



-You regularly forget follow-ups or rely on management to remind you about open tasks



-You prefer completing assigned tasks without reviewing the overall operation for problems



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, begin your application with the word HOMEFRONT.



Please attach your resume and answer ALL five questions below:



1. -How many years of U.S.-based property management experience do you have, and how many years have you actively used Buildium?



2. -Describe the accounting and bookkeeping functions you have personally completed inside Buildium. Please be specific.



3. -Describe your experience completing bank or trust account reconciliations. What was your personal responsibility in the reconciliation process?



4. -Tell us about a time you personally identified an accounting, ledger, or financial discrepancy. How did you discover it and what did you do?



5. -How many other clients or jobs are you currently working for, and are you available to work during California business hours?



Please do not submit a generic cover letter. We are specifically reviewing your answers to the questions above to evaluate your experience.



Applications that do not begin with HOMEFRONT or do not answer all five questions will not be considered.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is based on experience and demonstrated skill level, with opportunities for increased responsibility and long-term growth.



This position has the potential to grow into a leadership role within our operations team for the right person.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who wants to become an important part of our company's operations and growth.

title: Web Developer (Shopify + Wix) — Project-Based, with Part-Time/Full-Time + Benefits Potential
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



The Lavender Agency is a marketing strategy firm working with fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands. We're a small, senior team — brand design, media buying, SEO, marketing ops — and we're looking for the developer who completes it.



We have a Senior Brand + Graphic Designer who delivers strong, fully designed web pages. We do not need you to design. We need you to build, and build well.



THE FIRST PROJECT



A conversion-optimized landing page on Shopify for a jewelry e-commerce client. The design will be handed to you ready to build.



Rate: $12 USD/hour, capped at 30 hours. Hours are tracked in ClickUp. If you're approaching the cap, we expect you to flag it before you hit it — not after. How you handle that is part of how we evaluate you.



This is a real paid engagement and it's also how we assess fit. If the work is excellent and the collaboration is smooth, this becomes an ongoing part-time or full-time role on our team at the same rate, with a set weekly hour commitment.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build client web pages and full sites from designer-provided files — faithfully, down to the spacing

- Work across Shopify, Wix, and other platforms depending on what each client is on

- Version your work properly and hand off cleanly via GitHub

- Build for conversion: page speed, mobile-first, clean semantic structure

- Communicate early. We would rather hear about a problem at hour 10 than see it at hour 30.



REQUIRED



- Shopify— theme customization, Liquid, landing page and section builds

- Wix— confident building and editing

- GitHub— you version your work; you don't send zip files

- Ability to take a finished design file and translate it accurately to a live platform

- Clear written English and consistent, proactive communication



HOURS AND AVAILABILITY

Our team operates between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM US Eastern Time (8:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine Time). Your schedule within that window is flexible — we care about output, not clock-watching — but your working hours must fall inside it. We coordinate closely across design, development, and media, and that only works when we overlap. Please only apply if you can reliably work this schedule.



HIGHLY VALUED



- WordPress and Squarespace

- CRO and page speed optimization experience

- Genuine cross-platform range. Moving between Shopify, Wix, and WordPress in the same week without friction is what turns this into a full-time seat. A developer who only knows one platform can do this project. They can't do this job.



WHO THIS IS FOR



You're a builder, not a designer who codes. You take pride in a clean handoff. You'd rather ask one clarifying question upfront than guess and rebuild. You want to grow into a permanent seat on a team where your work ships to real brands.



TO APPLY, SEND:



1. Your portfolio — live links, and for each one, tell me which platform it was built on

2. Your resume or CV

3. One or two sentences on your availability and your typical turnaround for a single landing page



Applications that don't include the platform breakdown for each portfolio link will not be reviewed. This is the first thing we're testing.

title: TikTok Shop Video Editor
description:
JOB TITLE: Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok Shop / Reels / Shorts (Long-Term, Weekly Pay)





We are TikTok Shop Editors — we edit TikTok Shop, UGC, and organic videos for top creators who post at volume. Whether a creator is posting 10 videos or 300 per month, we handle the editing so they can stay focused on filming. We work with multiple TikTok Shop affiliates and creators, and we're growing fast.



We're hiring reliable video editors to join our team long-term. This is NOT a one-off project. We're looking to build lasting relationships with editors who grow with us — steady weekly volume, weekly pay, and more work as we onboard new creators.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit TikTok, Reels, and Shorts content for multiple creators

- Remove dead space and improve pacing

- Add cuts, zooms, captions, sound effects, and graphics when needed

- Adapt to different creator styles and different products

- Deliver videos quickly and consistently

- Handle revisions when requested (revisions are included on every client order)



TYPES OF EDITING WE ASSIGN



Basic Editing

- Dead space removal

- Cuts, zooms & pacing

- Simple captions



Premium Editing

- Everything in Basic

- Overlays, motion graphics & sound effects

- B-roll and advanced captions

- Visual effects

- Strong hooks and product-focused storytelling

- Conversion-focused editing designed to increase sales



You'll be matched to a tier based on your skill level.



MUST HAVES

- Proven experience editing short-form content (TikTok/Reels/Shorts)

- CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Understanding of retention, hooks, and viewer psychology

- Good English communication

- Fast, reliable turnaround times

- Able to handle consistent weekly volume (our creators post daily)



WHY WORK WITH US

- Long-term, ongoing role — we want editors we can count on for years, not weeks

- Paid weekly — no waiting until the end of the month

- Consistent volume with room to take on more as we grow

- Clear instructions and organized workflow for every batch



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word PACING so we know you read the full post. Then include:

1. Links to your best TikTok/Reels/Shorts examples

2. Examples of affiliate or product videos you've edited (if any)

3. What software you use

4. Your turnaround time for 10 videos

5. Your expected monthly salary or per-video rate



ONE LAST THING

We're looking for editors who understand that editing isn't just about making videos look good. Great editing improves retention and engagement — and for product videos, it helps sell. If you think about hooks, watch time, and conversions when you edit, we want to hear from you.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
TITLE: Marketing Operations Manager — Part-Time to Full-Time (Remote)

TYPE OF WORK: Part Time to Full-Time 

SALARY: $10 USD/hour

HOURS PER WEEK: 25 hrs/week to start; grows to 40 + benefits based on performance



---



JOB OVERVIEW



The Lavender Agency is a marketing strategy firm working with fashion, beauty, wellness, and lifestyle brands. We are hiring a Marketing Operations Manager to own the day-to-day execution engine across our client roster.



Read this part carefully, because it is the whole job.



We are not looking for an assistant. We are looking for the person who makes sure nothing is dropped — not by being told what to track, but by building the system that tracks it. If you walk into a disorganized process, your instinct should be to fix it, not to ask where the organized version is. There isn't one. You're it.



This starts part-time at 20 hours per week and grows to full-time based on performance.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY REQUIRES



Ownership. When something falls through the cracks, it is yours. We do not want explanations of what went wrong; we want the fix, and the change to the process that prevents it from recurring.



Self-direction. When you hit something you do not know, you try first. You look it up, you check the doc, you test it, you form a point of view. Then, if you still need us, you come with a proposed answer rather than an open question. Questions are welcome. Questions in place of effort are not.



Systems creation. You will not inherit a perfect operation. You will be handed real gaps and expected to close them — build the tracker, write the SOP, create the checklist, and then follow it.



Precision. Content gets published and tagged correctly the first time. Process steps get completed, not mostly completed. If you are the kind of person who finds your own mistakes before anyone else does, you will do well here.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Marketing execution

- Schedule and publish social content across platforms — accurately tagged, correctly formatted, on time

- Support engagement on LinkedIn and Instagram

- Schedule newsletters and marketing
s

- Upload blog and website content, including product and content updates in Shopify

- Request and respond to online reviews

- Quality-check your own work before it ships. Publishing errors are the failure mode we are most trying to eliminate.



Project management and operations

- Own ClickUp — tasks, timelines, statuses, assignments

- Drive deadlines across a team of designers, developers, media buyers, and SEO

- Chase what is missing before it becomes a problem, and escalate early rather than late

- Build and maintain marketing calendars, recurring workflows, and SOPs

- Create the operational structure this agency needs as it grows



Team and administrative support

- Prepare daily briefs outlining priorities and action items

- Capture meeting notes and convert them into tracked, owned tasks

- Run client onboarding workflows end to end

- Maintain organized folders, documents, and internal systems



REQUIRED



- Shopify experience — product uploads, page and content updates, basic backend navigation

- Demonstrated project management experience coordinating multiple people and deadlines

- Experience building a process or system from scratch, not just maintaining one

- ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar PM platform

- Google Workspace

- Social scheduling and
 marketing platforms

- Excellent written English

- The ability to work independently with minimal supervision



PREFERRED



- Agency experience, or supporting a founder or executive directly

- Fashion, beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brand experience

- SEO, paid media, or web development coordination exposure

- ChatGPT and AI workflow tools

- Notion, Typeform, Zapier



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- Someone who waits to be assigned work

- Someone who asks before attempting

- Someone who needs the system to already exist

- Someone who considers a task complete when the last step is skipped



If any of those describe you honestly, this role will frustrate both of us.



HOURS AND AVAILABILITY



Our team operates between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM US Eastern Time (8:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine Time). Your schedule within that window is flexible — we care about output, not clock-watching — but your working hours must fall inside it. We coordinate closely across design, development, and media, and that only works when we overlap. Please only apply if you can reliably work this schedule.



THE PATH



Part-time at 20 hours per week, growing to full-time at 40 hours per week based on performance. Performance-based rate increases available. We promote from inside.



TO APPLY, SEND:



1. Your resume

2. Your Shopify experience, specifically — what have you built or managed in it?

3. A process or system you built from scratch. What was broken, what did you build, what changed?

4. Answer this: You are mid-task and hit something you do not know how to do. What are the first three things you do before asking someone for help?

5. The word "Lavender" somewhere in your application, so we know you read the full posting



Applications that skip questions 3 or 4 will not be reviewed.

title: Email Marketing Specialist — 5% of All Revenue You Generate| START ASAP
description:

## The Deal, Up Front

 marketing. Across every store. Across every country.**

---



We're looking for a **truly professional, advanced
 Marketing Specialist** to own and scale
 marketing across a fast-growing DTC brand. This role is specifically for candidates based in the Philippines.



**We want someone to start immediately. We are hiring right now and we want you in as fast as possible.**



**Read this first: send your portfolio with your application. No portfolio, no consideration.**



We need to see proven, advanced
 marketing work — real campaigns, real flows, real revenue numbers. Not "I've done some
 marketing before." We mean advanced, high-level experience. If you don't have that, this role is not for you.



We use the **Shopify
 app** — we do not use Klaviyo. You must be comfortable working inside Shopify: the
 app, customer segments, discount codes, product feeds, order data, and everything connected to it.

- **Denmark**

- **Finland**

- **UK**

- **Worldwide**

## Language Requirement (Basic, But Critical)



**Every
 must be in the language of the market it's sent to.**



- Sweden ? Swedish

- Norway ? Norwegian

- Denmark ? Danish

- Finland ? Finnish

- UK ? English

- Netherlands ? Dutch



You don't need to speak these languages yourself, but you must be able to manage properly localized campaigns — correct language, correct currency, correct market segmentation, correct sending list. No English
s going out to Swedish customers. No Swedish
s going to Denmark. This is basic, and we take it seriously.



## Responsibilities



- Build and run the full
 program: campaigns **and** automated flows

- Set up and optimize core flows: welcome, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, re-engagement, review requests, upsell/cross-sell

- Own deliverability: domain authentication, sender reputation, list hygiene, spam avoidance, inbox placement

- Grow and manage the
 list

- Run A/B tests on subject lines, offers, timing, and creative

- Localize campaigns correctly per market

- Analyze performance and report on revenue, open rate, CTR, conversion rate, and revenue per

- Set up and manage everything across all our stores and markets as we launch them

- Create engaging video content for
 campaigns



## Requirements



- **A portfolio of previous
 marketing collaborations — submitted with your application.** Non-negotiable. We need to see your past work and your results.

- **Advanced, proven track record in
 marketing.** Not entry-level. Not "some experience." We're looking for someone who has already run serious
 programs and can prove it with numbers.

- **Strong Shopify experience.** You know your way around the platform, not just the
 app.

- **Deep expertise in campaign management and flow building** — you should be able to handle every aspect of
 marketing and optimize every campaign for success.

- **You know all the tricks.** Deliverability, inbox placement, segmentation, subject line testing, flows, automations, list warming, re-engagement, send timing, offer structuring, copywriting for conversion — all of it. You know the craft inside out and don't need to be taught the basics.

- **Experience with international / multi-market
** is a big plus.

- **Video editing experience is a significant advantage.** You'll be expected to create engaging video content for our
 campaigns.

- **Reliable communication and availability.** We move fast, and we need someone who moves with us.

- **Available to start immediately.**



## What We Want to Know From You



We don't take just anyone for this job. This needs to be a seriously strong person within
 marketing.



Tell us about your vision. We want to understand what you're aiming for and where you want to go — the same way we'll be open about ours.



## How to Apply



Include all of the following:



1. **Your portfolio** — previous
 marketing work, with real numbers (revenue, open rates, CTR, conversion)

2. **Which brands/stores you've worked with** and what you specifically did

3. **Your Shopify experience** — what you've built and managed

4. **Whether you have video editing experience**

5. **Your vision** — what you're aiming for, and what you'd want to build with us

6. **When you can start**



**Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.**



We're hiring right now and we want the right person in immediately.

You can turn a written brief into a finished, scroll-stopping ad without hand-holding.

title: DM setter/ virtual assistant
description:
My name is Peter and I am the cofounder of Fahrenheit Fat Loss. 



About Fahrenheit Fat Loss:



Fahrenheit Fat Loss is a premium online coaching company that helps busy women, especially moms between the ages of 30 and 50, lose 20 to 40 pounds and keep it off for life.



We believe most women don't need another diet. They need a system that fits their real life.



Our coaching combines customized nutrition, strength training, accountability, mindset coaching, and habit change into one simple process that helps women lose weight without giving up their families, careers, or favorite foods.



Our mission is to help women build confidence, regain control of their health, and become the strongest version of themselves, physically and mentally.



Unlike programs that rely on quick fixes or temporary motivation, The Fahrenheit Method is designed to create lasting lifestyle change so our clients only have to lose the weight once.



Our coaching is backed by a results guarantee because we're confident in the system we've built and the support we provide.



Today, Fahrenheit Fat Loss serves women across the United States through a high touch online coaching experience and has helped hundreds of women transform not only their bodies, but their confidence, energy, and quality of life.



We're building a brand that women genuinely trust. Every conversation matters. Every message matters. Every interaction should leave someone feeling understood, challenged, and inspired to become the best version of themselves.



If you're joining our team, you're not just answering DMs or scheduling calls. You're helping change lives.



***I want to be very clear about what I am looking for in a DM setter for Fahrenheit Fat Loss.***



This is not a copy and paste position, a customer service role, or a job where you simply agree with every prospect and make them feel better. Your responsibility is to create real conversations, understand what someone is struggling with, challenge their thinking when necessary, qualify them properly, and confidently move the right people toward booking a call.



You must be available every day from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM Eastern Time. Monday-Saturday. These are the hours when our audience is most active, so reliability and consistency during these shifts are extremely important.



You need to be fluent in written English. Your messages must sound natural, confident, intelligent, and conversational. I do not want robotic responses, awkward wording, generic scripts, or messages that sound like they were copied directly from ChatGPT.



You may use AI to help organize information, review grammar, or improve efficiency, but you cannot depend on it to have conversations for you. You need to know how to think critically, read the tone of a conversation, ask the right follow up question, handle objections, and know when to show empathy versus when someone needs to be challenged.



You will need to study me and the Fahrenheit brand closely. That means watching my content, reading my captions, listening to how I speak, understanding my personality, learning my coaching philosophy, knowing our client success stories, and understanding the women we help.



You should know who I am, what I do, where I live, what I believe in, how I coach, how I communicate, and why prospects choose Fahrenheit. The goal is for someone messaging the account to feel like they are speaking directly with me.



You must have a strong understanding of fitness, nutrition, fat loss, and the mindset required to get results. You should also live a disciplined and healthy lifestyle yourself. I want someone who genuinely represents the standards of the brand.



Your main responsibilities will include:



Responding to incoming Instagram and
 messages quickly.



Starting conversations with new followers and warm leads.



Building rapport without wasting time in endless small talk.



Learning about each prospect’s goals, struggles, urgency, and readiness for coaching.



Qualifying prospects financially and emotionally before booking them.



Moving qualified prospects toward scheduling a sales call.



Following up with leads consistently instead of allowing conversations to disappear.



Confirming appointments and helping improve call attendance.



Keeping accurate notes and updating every lead inside GoHighLevel.



Using Typeform, Instagram,
, Meta Business Suite, Google Sheets, and any other systems required for the position.



Reviewing previous conversations so prospects never have to repeat themselves.



Communicating important information to me clearly and quickly.



You will be expected to book a minimum of 3 qualified calls per week at the beginning. That is the starting standard, not the long term ceiling. As you learn the brand, the offer, and our audience, I expect that number to increase.



A qualified call means the prospect understands what the call is for, has a real problem they want help solving, is open to coaching, has shown some level of commitment, and is not simply booking because they were pressured.



Quality matters just as much as quantity. I do not want a calendar full of people who are unqualified, confused, or unlikely to show up.



The right person for this role is disciplined, organized, competitive, emotionally intelligent, trustworthy, and able to work without being constantly reminded what to do. You should take ownership of your conversations, notice when something is not working, and communicate solutions instead of waiting for instructions.



I am willing to invest time in helping the right person understand the Fahrenheit brand, but I am not looking to teach someone basic communication, work ethic, English, or how to speak with prospects. You should already be proficient in those areas.



I am looking for someone who wants to become a long term part of the company, improve their skills, produce measurable results, and grow as Fahrenheit grows.



Before moving forward, I will want to see examples of how you communicate, how you would respond to different types of prospects, how you handle objections, and how you would move a conversation toward a call without sounding scripted or aggressive.
