title: UX Designer – eCommerce & Conversion Rate Optimization
description:
We are looking for a UX Designer who truly understands how users behave — and how great design directly drives revenue.



This role is NOT about making things look pretty. It's about making things WORK.



---



WHO WE ARE



We are a performance-driven eCommerce team. Every design decision we make is measured by one question: Does it convert? We believe in data-backed design, clean user flows, and removing every possible barrier between a visitor and a purchase. UX at our company is a growth tool — not a decoration department.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Design and optimize UX flows for eCommerce stores (product pages, PDPs, checkout, cart, landing pages)

- Identify conversion bottlenecks and propose testable, hypothesis-driven solutions

- Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma

- Conduct UX audits on existing stores and present actionable improvements

- Collaborate closely with our team to implement and A/B test design changes

- Stay current with eCommerce UX best practices, CRO frameworks, and buyer psychology



---



OUR UX PRINCIPLES (Read carefully — this defines how we work)



1. Function over aesthetics. A beautiful design that doesn't convert is a failed design. Every element must serve a purpose.

2. Less friction, more revenue. We remove every unnecessary click, scroll, and decision from the user's path to purchase.

3. Design for the user, not for yourself. We don't care if something looks clever. We care if it works for real customers.

4. Data is your compass. Gut feeling is a starting point — not a conclusion. We test, measure, and iterate.

5. Clarity beats creativity. If a user has to think twice, we've already lost them.

6. Mobile-first, always. The majority of eCommerce traffic is mobile. If it doesn't work perfectly on mobile, it doesn't ship.

7. Speed matters. Every second of load time costs conversions. Design must consider performance.



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong experience in UX design for eCommerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar platforms)

- Solid understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) principles and best practices

- Proficiency in Figma — you must be able to design and prototype natively in Figma

- Ability to think in user journeys, funnels, and behavioral patterns

- Knowledge of A/B testing concepts (Hotjar, Google Optimize, VWO, or similar tools is a plus)

- Strong eye for UX copy — microcopy, CTAs, and headlines that convert

- Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines



---



HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT: Applications without a video will NOT be considered.



To apply, you must submit a short video (2–5 minutes) in which you:



1. Walk us through at least one Figma UX design you created for an eCommerce context (product page, checkout, landing page, etc.)

2. Explain WHY you made specific design decisions — focus on conversion and user behavior, not aesthetics

3. If you don't have existing eCommerce projects: Pick any real online store, identify a UX/CRO problem on it, and show us how you would redesign or improve it in Figma. We are more interested in how you THINK than what you've already done.



Your video should demonstrate: clear thinking, knowledge of eCommerce UX, and a conversion-first mindset.



No video = no review. This is non-negotiable.



---



We look forward to meeting designers who design with purpose.

title: Figma + Squarespace Web Designer
description:
We are looking for a thoughtful web designer to support our small digital team.



We build websites and brand systems for therapists, mental health practices, and other care-based businesses. Most of the work involves Figma designs, Squarespace websites, and WordPress/Elementor projects.



This role is for someone who understands website design, not just graphic design.



A good website is not just a bunch of pretty sections. It needs structure, hierarchy, spacing, flow, clear calls to action, and a design that actually makes sense for the platform it will be built on.



You would be joining our design team and reporting to our Head of Design.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make social media graphics. We need someone who can help with real website design, client-facing projects, and platform-aware layouts.





Important requirement:



You must be fluent in Tagalog and English (sorry, no exceptions)



Most communication will be in English, but we are specifically looking for someone who can also communicate comfortably in Tagalog when needed.







What you’ll be working on:



  You may help with:



- Website layouts in Figma

- Homepage and service page designs

- Squarespace website designs and builds

- WordPress/Elementor design layouts

- Designing in a way that can actually be built cleanly in Squarespace or Elementor

- Brand identity work

- Logo concepts

- Website sections and simple design systems

- Design revisions based on team and client feedback

- Supporting active client projects alongside our design team



Some projects will be very structured. Others will require you to think through the layout and make smart design decisions.





What we’re looking for:



  You should have:



- Strong Figma experience

- Real Squarespace experience

- A good eye for spacing, typography, hierarchy, and flow

- Strong visual design and layout skills

- Ability to design desktop and mobile layouts

- Ability to design with platform limitations in mind

- Ability to read and follow briefs carefully

- Ability to ask questions before going too far in the wrong direction

- Ability to take feedback without getting defensive

- Good communication and reliability



You DO NOT need to be a full WordPress/Elementor developer.



But you do need to understand how to design for WordPress/Elementor so the developer is not guessing or fighting the design later.



That means thinking about:



- Section structure

- Responsive behavior

- Spacing and padding

- Reusable components

- Button styles

- Image sizing

- Mobile stacking

- What should be simple versus what should be custom







What matters here:



A strong portfolio matters.



But the day-to-day work matters more.



We need someone who can slow down enough to understand the brief, think through the page, ask questions when something is unclear, and check their own work before handing it off.



We do not need someone who tries to make every section overly complicated.



We need someone who can make a site feel polished, clean, thoughtful, and easy to understand.



The goal is not just to finish tasks quickly. The goal is to create work that is accurate, intentional, and aligned with the client.





Nice to have:



- WordPress or Elementor familiarity

- Experience designing for therapists, coaches, healthcare, wellness, or service-based businesses

- Logo and branding experience

- Basic understanding of responsive web design

- Comfort working with client copy and turning it into a clear page layout



Hours and pay



- Part-time

- 20-25 hours per week

- $6/hr to $7/hr to start; For someone with strong Figma and real Squarespace experience, we may start at up to $7/hour

- Paid weekly

- Initial 30-day probationary period



This is a long-term role for the right person.







How to apply:





Please
 your application directly to:







Use the subject line:



Figma + Squarespace Designer Application - [Your Favorite Filipino Snack]



Please include:



- 2 to 3 Figma website designs

- 2 to 3 live Squarespace websites you personally designed or built

- Any WordPress/Elementor design examples, if you have them

- A short explanation of your role in each project





Please DON'T send just a portfolio link.



For the Figma examples, send the Figma links if you can.



For the Squarespace examples, send the live website links and explain what you personally handled.





Also answer these three questions:



- When designing in Figma, how do you make sure the design can actually be built cleanly in Squarespace?

- If a design is being handed off to a WordPress/Elementor developer, what notes or details do you usually include?

- Just to make sure you read the full post: what is your favorite Filipino snack or comfort food?





One last thing:



We’re excited to see your work, but please take a little time with the application. The strongest applications will show how you think through design, layout, platform limitations, feedback, and handoff, not just which tools you know.



The way you present your application, portfolio links, project examples, and explanations gives us a sense of how you would present website work to our team. Applications that feel generic, copied and pasted, AI-written, disorganized, or hard to follow may not be reviewed closely.



Think of the application as your first small assignment. We’re looking for someone thoughtful, careful, and clear

mbers learned the workflow within a few days and are now working fully independently )

What kind of videos will you create?

Simple UGC-like short-form videos fully based on the provided scripts by us. Some of them are silently advertising products at the end but the key is that it doesn't sound like an ad but rather a native short-form video which a real person/influencer would record with their iPhone. There are a few styles such as just a calm "sit down" video ( where there's only one image and the influencer would just talk for 2 minutes ) or other ones where there're a few "shots" of them with a few seconds each and the scenes change but it's really not difficult at all - just a few more generations and then connecting them in CapCut.





The process is straightforward:

Getting our scripts ready and approved, using your own creativity and generating high quality base images using tools like Nano Banana Pro, turning these images into video clips using platforms like Veo3, voice cloning it, dead air cuts and trimming, other minor adjustments such as background audio effects if needed ( like supermarket background audio ). Whole process is 90% just creating the right images/video clips etc. Everything is shown clearly in the training.



You’ll be creating a lot of videos a day but these are not complex edits AT ALL. Difficulty level: 6/10 ( again, 80% is just generating the rate "input" images and later just animating them with voice. That's it )

Daily workload ( important )

In reality, you'd have exactly 4 unique "AI influencers" but all of 4 them have the same scripts to use, you'd just need to change a few words to help with the context ( some of them might be talking only about "dogs" but some about "cats" so just need to change a few words to make it all make sense ) and you could use the same image prompts to generate almost identical images for each influencer. In reality it’s just 2 to 6 original videos PER INFLUENCER ( 4 of them ) and each with a very similar structure. Once trained, this is very manageable.



Your job is simple:

Create the videos, export them, and send them to us daily on our Google Drive.

That’s it. No posting. No account management. No stress.







Equipment & storage ( we make this easy )

You’ll need a good computer that can smoothly handle 1080p/light 4k video editing ( we’ll do 1080p but we’re going to work on multiple browser tabs ), a stable internet connection, and at least 16GB of RAM and 250GB+ of fast storage AVAILABLE. 1TB+ of SSD storage is preferred ( make sure it’s SSD and not old and slow HDD ).

mber, not disposable labor.

s back and forth.

Already done some AI influencers related jobs and have good experience in: Google VEO3, Nano Banana Pro, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut PRO and other similar tools. Our slides feature a suede memory foam insole, adjustable velcro straps, and a streetwear-first aesthetic. Think socks with slides, baggy fits, and the kind of product people actually want to show off.



**The Role**



We need someone to own our TikTok Shop affiliate program end to end. This is a remote, full-time position. You'll be the person finding creators, reviewing their profiles, reaching out to them, managing samples, sourcing TikTok Live sellers, and making sure affiliates are actually posting and converting.



**What You'll Do**



- Search TikTok Shop's creator marketplace and find affiliates who fit our brand (streetwear, sneaker culture, lifestyle, men's fashion)

- Review creator profiles using Cruva — check GMV history, video performance, follower quality, and brand fit before approving sample requests

- Send outreach messages to qualified creators and follow up with affiliates who ghosted after receiving samples

- Source and recruit creators specifically for TikTok Live selling — we generate strong revenue from livestreams and need people who can actually sell on camera

- Stay on top of TikTok trends and proactively suggest video formats, hooks, and content angles that will work for our product

- Track affiliate performance weekly and escalate top performers for paid partnerships or higher commissions

- Manage the full sample request queue — approve, reject, or message creators based on their profile



**What We're Looking For**



- Hands-on experience with Cruva (required — this is our primary tool for managing affiliates)

- Experience with TikTok Shop seller tools (creator marketplace, sample requests, Seller Center)

- Strong eye for content — you should be able to watch a creator's recent videos and quickly assess whether they can move product

- Experience sourcing or managing TikTok Live sellers is a strong plus

- Solid English writing for creator outreach and follow-ups

- Self-directed and organized — you'll be managing a daily queue without someone micromanaging you

- Bonus: familiar with Claude AI or other AI tools for outreach and research



**Compensation**



- Fixed monthly rate (discussed based on experience)

- Performance bonus tied to affiliate GMV



**Hours**



Full-time



---



**To Apply — Complete Both Tasks First**



Applications without these will not be reviewed.



---



**Task 1: Diagnose These Affiliates**



Below are three real affiliates from our TikTok Shop. Tell us what you see and exactly what you would do.



Affiliate 1: @ejwayy

- 520,000 followers

- Average video views: 42,385

- Videos posted for us: 2

- Total brand GMV generated: $8,430

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $4,835

- Status: Has not posted in a long time



Affiliate 2: @brackxtt

- 18,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 44 | Lives: 3

- Total brand GMV: $15,599

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $54,530

- Content quality score: 91/100

- Status: Requested a new sample over a month ago. Never posted after receiving it.



**Affiliate 

- 36,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 158

- Total brand GMV: $7,543 (~$47 per video)

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $84,830

- Content quality score: 95/100

- Average video views: 735

- Status: Posts consistently but barely converts



For each affiliate, answer:



1. What's actually going on here? Give us your honest read on the situation.

2. What would you do next? Be specific — not "follow up," but what you'd actually do and why.

3. Write the exact message you'd send them right now.



---



**Task 2: Find Us 5 Affiliates**



Go to TikTok Shop's creator marketplace or use Cruva and find 5 creators you would actually recruit for DracoSlides right now.



For each one, give us:

1. Their TikTok handle

2. Follower count and average views

3. One sentence on why you think they're a fit



---



Paste everything directly in your application. No cover letter needed. Just these two tasks.

title: Real Estate AI Marketing & Content Manager
description:
I am looking for a Real Estate AI Marketing & Content Manager with at least 3 years' experience working with U.S. real estate professionals to help grow and manage the online marketing, branding, and social media presence for my real estate business.



This is not a basic VA role. I am looking for someone who already understands real estate marketing, can think strategically, create polished content, use AI tools to work efficiently, and proactively bring ideas to the table instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.



You will be supporting a solo Realtor brand and helping market me, my listings, and my services across social media and related marketing platforms. I need someone who can combine content strategy, content creation, graphics, social media management, analytics, and selected marketing-tool execution into one strong role.



I am not looking for someone to simply “post on social media.” I’m looking for someone who can help strengthen my brand, improve my content strategy, create high-quality marketing assets, stay current with trends, analyze what’s working, and help turn social media into a more effective lead-generation and brand-building tool for my business.



If you are highly organized, creative, analytical, detail-oriented, and already have experience supporting Realtors or real estate brands with social media and digital marketing, I’d love to hear from you.



________________________________________



Hours / Availability

• This is an ongoing flexible role

• Must be able to overlap at least some hours between 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM CST

• Hours will depend on workload, performance, and overall fit

• I care more about quality, ownership, strategy, and results than simply filling a set number of hours

• For the right person, there is room for the role to grow over time based on business needs and demonstrated value

________________________________________



What I Need Help With

Your primary focus will be helping me build a stronger, smarter, more consistent marketing engine for my real estate business.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Social Media Strategy & Content Planning

• Develop and manage a strategic content calendar for my real estate brand

• Plan content for
, Instagram, TikTok, Google Business Profile, and YouTube

• Create content that helps market:

o me as a Realtor / personal brand

o my listings

o my real estate services

o buyer and seller education

o local market expertise / local lifestyle content

o lead generation and trust-building content

• Bring proactive ideas for campaigns, content angles, social growth, and brand positioning

• Help identify what content should be posted, why, and how it supports business goals



2) Content Creation, Repurposing & Publishing

• Create and repurpose short-form and long-form real estate content

• Turn listing details, property features, market updates, FAQs, voice notes, and rough ideas into strong social content

• Create content such as:

o listing promo posts

o reels / short videos

o carousel posts

o educational buyer/seller content

o market update content

o branded social graphics

o story content

o review / testimonial / social proof content

• Help maintain a consistent posting rhythm and organized publishing workflow across priority platforms



3) Graphic Design & Video / Reel Editing

• Create polished, branded graphics and marketing pieces in Canva (and other tools if applicable)

• Design materials such as:

o just listed / open house / price improvement / under contract / sold graphics

o listing marketing graphics

o educational carousels and branded posts

o story graphics and promotional assets

o lead magnet / campaign graphics

o YouTube thumbnails / reel covers if needed

• Edit short-form videos / reels for social media

• Help maintain a strong, consistent visual brand across platforms



4) Analytics, Reporting & Content Optimization

• Track social media performance and help analyze what is and is not working

• Review content performance and provide recommendations on:

o content topics and themes

o hooks and messaging

o engagement trends

o audience growth

o content formats to repeat or improve

o ways to improve reach, quality, and consistency

• Help identify what content deserves to be doubled down on vs dropped

• Support tracking through tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, and other relevant platform analytics



5) Community Management & Brand Presence

• Help monitor comments, messages, engagement, and audience interactions

• Support community management and help maintain a professional, responsive online presence

• Help maximize reviews, testimonials, and social proof where appropriate



6) Real Estate Marketing Tools & Marketing System Support

• Help manage marketing-related tasks inside tools such as:

o Listings to Leads

o Ylopo

o Publer

o other real estate marketing tools as needed

• Support marketing campaigns, lead-gen assets, social promotion, landing pages, and branded materials tied to these tools

• Help keep marketing systems organized and functioning smoothly

________________________________________



SECONDARY / PREFERRED RESPONSIBILITIES

These are valuable, but they are not the main reason I’m hiring. If you already have experience in these areas, that is a plus:

• SEO-related marketing support

• keyword research / basic on-page SEO understanding

• meta-tagging / geo-tagging / image metadata support

• Meta /
 ads support

• ManyChat / chatbot-related marketing support

• online research tied to content, marketing, or SEO

• light real estate marketing admin support as needed

________________________________________



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

• Experience supporting a Realtor, real estate team, brokerage, or real estate brand with social media and/or digital marketing

• Strong understanding of real estate content and marketing, including how to market:

o listings

o buyer and seller services

o educational real estate content

o a personal brand as a Realtor

• Strong Canva skills and ability to create polished, professional graphics

• Experience creating short-form content and editing reels/videos for social media

• Comfortable using AI tools to support content ideation, repurposing, caption writing, workflow efficiency, and content creation

• Ability to think strategically and bring ideas proactively

• Strong written English and ability to create clean, professional marketing copy

• Detail-oriented and organized

• Able to follow written and verbal instructions well

• Strong sense of ownership and follow-through

• Must be able to work independently and not wait to be told every tiny next step

________________________________________



PREFERRED TOOLS / EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• Listings to Leads

• Ylopo

• Canva

• Adobe Photoshop

• Google Workspace / Google Suite

• Publer

• Meta Business Suite

• Google Analytics

• SEMrush / SEO tools

• ManyChat

• MLS systems such as Paragon and FlexMLS

• AI tools for content creation, repurposing, video editing, research, and workflow support

________________________________________



IMPORTANT: THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…

• You need constant direction and are waiting for me to tell you exactly what to do every day

• You do not already understand the basics of real estate marketing

• You do not enjoy thinking strategically about content and brand growth

• Your work is rushed, sloppy, or full of avoidable mistakes

• You only know how to do basic posting but not actual content planning, repurposing, graphics, or performance analysis

________________________________________



COMPENSATION

Compensation depends on experience, portfolio quality, and overall fit for the role.

________________________________________



TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short note explaining your experience working with Realtors, real estate brands, or real estate marketing

3. Examples of real estate social media content, graphics, or marketing materials you’ve created

4. A list of AI tools you currently use for content creation, repurposing, editing, analytics, or workflow efficiency — and how you use them

5. A short explanation of how you would help a solo Realtor improve their social media presence and content strategy

6. Your desired hourly rate

7. Your weekly availability

Please include the phrase “Real Estate Marketing Pro” in your application subject line or first message so I know you read the full job post.

description:
Marketing Specialist – Performance & Conversion Analytics (Remote / Work From Home)



Do you get excited when a small tweak to a CTA doubles the click-through rate?



If you love turning marketing data into "here's exactly what we should do next," this role is for you. We're looking for a Marketing Specialist who understands how selling actually works online — someone who can track what's making money, spot what's wasting it, and tell us clearly how to fix it.

You won't be guessing. You'll be measuring, testing, and improving real campaigns that drive real sales.



What You'll Do



Track and report on key channel metrics (CTR, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, ROAS, average order value, and more)

Work side-by-side with our accountant to connect marketing spend to revenue — showing what each channel earns vs. costs, and flagging where to cut, fix, or scale

Partner with our marketer to test and measure CTAs — identifying which calls-to-action convert best

Track attribution: the % of traffic and sales coming from QR codes, unique links, and specific campaigns

Monitor landing page performance (drop-off, bounce, conversion) and recommend improvements

Run A/B tests, document what works, and turn results into simple, actionable recommendations

Build clean, easy-to-read reports the whole team (and our partners) can understand



What We're Looking For



Real, hands-on experience in marketing, performance marketing, growth, or marketing analytics

A solid grasp of CTAs, selling products, and how to test and improve them

Comfort with analytics tools (Google Analytics/GA4, Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets) and tracking methods (UTM links, QR codes)

You understand core metrics — CTR, conversion rate, CPA, ROAS, AOV — and know how to move them in the right direction

A tester's mindset: you like experiments, data, and figuring out why something worked

A clear communicator who can explain numbers simply and collaborate well with a marketer and an accountant

Reliable internet and your own computer



Salary starts at $400/month — with a clear, fast path to your target rate based on performance.

We believe in paying for results, not just promises. You'll start at $400/month, and because this role is measured in clear numbers (the metrics you'll be tracking), strong performance is easy to prove. Hit your targets and we'll move you up to your desired salary — quickly, and without you having to fight for it.



No fancy degree required — we care about proven results and how you think.

Why Work With Us



Your work directly impacts revenue — you'll see the results of your recommendations

A collaborative team that values data over guesswork

Genuine room to grow as we scale

Remote flexibility and a supportive, low-drama environment



How to Apply

This is a real, specific role and we review every application personally. To apply, please fill out our short application form here: 

In the form, tell us about one metric you improved in a past role and how you did it. (Applications submitted only through the form will be reviewed.)

title: Lead Generation & Sales Outreach VA
description:
LEAD GENERATION & SALES OUTREACH VA

Part time, remote (Philippines). Starting at 10 hours a week, growing to 20 or more as the role develops.



ABOUT NE SUPPORT

NE Support is a UK business support company helping founder led small businesses grow. We provide marketing, operations, business development and reporting services to a portfolio of clients. We are an AI first business: much of our research and outreach is produced with Claude (including Claude Cowork) and then refined by people who care about quality.



THE ROLE

This is a new role focused on growth. You will help the founder, Louise, bring in new business, both for NE Support and for our clients, by finding the right prospects, building clean targeted lists, and running warm, personalised outreach that starts real conversations. You will also support the tender and bid process behind the scenes, handling the research and admin around it rather than writing the bids themselves, which Louise does. Your job is to qualify the leads properly, personalise the outreach so it never reads like spam, chase the follow ups, and keep the pipeline tidy.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Lead generation and list building using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and similar tools, with verified contact details.

- Sales outreach and appointment setting: personalised cold
 and LinkedIn outreach in our voice, managing follow ups and booking qualified calls.

- Pipeline and CRM: keep the CRM and prospect trackers accurate (for example HubSpot, GoHighLevel or Zoho).

- Tender and bid support (not the writing): monitor UK tender portals such as Find a Tender and Contracts Finder, gather supporting documents, format and proofread responses, and manage submissions and deadlines.

- Research: verify prospect and company details and keep the data clean.

- Reporting: a short weekly summary of outreach sent, replies and meetings booked.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 2 to 3 years in lead generation, sales outreach or appointment setting, ideally B2B and handling more than one client at a time.

- Hands on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and an outreach or enrichment tool such as Apollo, Instantly or Lemlist. Essential.

- Daily, confident use of Claude. We run our work in Claude, not ChatGPT. Real experience with Claude Cowork is a strong advantage.

- CRM experience (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho or similar).

- Excellent written English, in British English, warm and human. Your outreach should sound like a real person, not a template. Essential.

- A computer that can run Claude Cowork: an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer) or Windows 10 or 11 Pro. Windows Home and older Intel Macs cannot run it.

- Organised, persistent and comfortable working to targets.



NICE TO HAVE

 deliverability know how (domain warm up, SPF and DKIM), experience selling into UK markets, familiarity with UK public sector tenders and procurement, and Notion or ClickUp.



HOURS, PAY AND TERMS

- Start at 10 hours a week, growing to 20 or more as the work grows. Please only apply if you have room to take on more hours over time.

- At least 2 to 3 of your daily hours should overlap with UK mornings (roughly 4pm to 7pm Philippine time).

- Rate: 6 to 10 US dollars per hour depending on experience, paid monthly via Wise or your preferred platform.

- 13th month pay, pro rata.

- Paid 4 week trial period, then ongoing if we are both happy.

- Long term role. We want someone who grows with the business.



HOW TO APPLY

 
 with the subject line: Lead Gen VA, [your name]. Applications without this subject line will not be read (this is our attention to detail test).

Please include:

- Your CV and links to any relevant work or results.

- A short note (not a template) on the AI tools you use daily and how you use them.

- One or two sentences on a time you ran lead generation or outreach for a client, and any results (reply rates or meetings booked).

- Which lead generation and outreach tools you use, and any CRM you are comfortable in.

- Your current weekly availability and confirmation you can grow to 20 or more hours.

- What computer and operating system you use, and whether you already use Claude and Claude Cowork.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid sample task: building a small list of 15 to 20 qualified leads for a target we provide, plus a three
 cold outreach sequence written in our brand voice.

Strong understanding of:

Coinsurance

Patient financial responsibility

title: SEO Specialist — Local SEO, On-Page SEO & Review Generation
description:
About Us

Exponential Oaks is a web development and design agency with digital marketing integrations based in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, serving home service contractors — HVAC, plumbing, electricians, and home remodeling companies. We build custom websites and run their marketing, and SEO is the backbone that makes both work together.



About the Role

We're hiring an SEO Specialist to own every SEO-related deliverable across our retainer tiers and web builds — from Google Business Profile management on our smallest accounts to technical SEO on custom-built sites with dynamic quote forms. You'll also own review generation and management, since strong SEO and strong review velocity go hand in hand.



What You'll Do

Local SEO (all retainer tiers):



Google Business Profile setup, optimization, and ongoing management

Local citation building and NAP consistency across directories

Local keyword research specific to each client's service area and trade

Automated review generation setup (post-job request flows) and review response management



On-page & technical SEO (web builds):



On-page optimization for new Starter, Growth, and Signature Build sites (title tags, meta descriptions, header structure, internal linking)

Technical SEO audits — site speed, mobile usability, schema markup, crawlability — especially on custom Supabase-backed builds where standard SEO plugins don't apply

Ensure new landing pages (service pages, location pages, seasonal pages) are built SEO-first from day one, not retrofitted after launch



Ongoing (Growth & Partner retainer tiers):



Monthly SEO reporting tied to actual ranking and lead volume, not just vanity metrics

Content recommendations for blog/service pages that support the local SEO strategy

Competitor gap analysis within each client's specific trade and county



Platforms & Tools You Should Know

SEO research & tracking:



Google Search Console and Google Analytics (required)

Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz (at least one required for keyword research and rank tracking)

Screaming Frog for technical/crawl audits



Local SEO & citations:



Google Business Profile Manager (required)

BrightLocal or Whitespark for citation building and rank tracking

Yext or similar for listing management (nice to have)



Review generation & reputation:



Experience with a review automation platform (e.g., Podium, NiceJob, Birdeye, or similar) — tool flexibility is fine, but you should understand the workflow



Technical/schema:



Schema markup implementation (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ schema) — via Google's Structured Data tools or similar

Basic familiarity with PageSpeed Insights / Core Web Vitals



Reporting:



Comfortable building clear client-facing reports in Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or a similar dashboard tool

title: Service Dispatch & Assigner
description:
Job Overview

Are you a master multi-tasker who thrives in a fast-paced environment? Do you love solving the daily puzzle of logistics while keeping both field technicians and customers happy?



We are seeking a sharp, highly organized Service Dispatcher & Assigner to serve as the air traffic control for our field operations across Texas and Minnesota. In this role, you will be the primary link between our customers, our field technicians, and our internal management team. You’ll be responsible for maximizing our tech efficiency, keeping data pristine, and ensuring our daily operations run like a well-oiled machine.



If you are calm under pressure, quick on your feet, and love a dynamic workday where no two days are exactly the same, we want to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Job Dispatch & Routing

Smart Scheduling: Assign incoming jobs to the right technician based on priority, geographic location (TX/MN), and real-time technician availability.

Route Optimization: Build and continuously adjust daily schedules to maximize technician efficiency and minimize downtime.

Real-Time Adjustments: Pivot and reroute jobs on the fly to handle last-minute cancellations, no-shows, or urgent emergencies.

2. Technician Communication & Support

Field Support: Act as the primary point of contact for technicians throughout the day—confirming job details, answering questions, and helping troubleshoot on-site scheduling issues.

Live Updates: Seamlessly push schedule changes and high-priority jobs out to technicians as they happen.

Status Tracking: Closely monitor technician statuses (en route, on-site, completed, available) to ensure all dispatch decisions are made using real-time data.

3. Customer Communication

Expectation Management: Confirm appointment windows, handle reschedule requests, and proactively notify customers if a technician is running behind.

First Contact: Serve as the first line of communication for customer scheduling questions.

Smart Escalation: Identify and escalate larger customer issues (complaints, disputes, urgent escalations) to the appropriate manager instead of trying to solve everything solo.

4. Job Data Accuracy

Data Integrity: Log job outcomes (sold, cancelled, callback, rescheduled, etc.) into our tracking sheets accurately and on the same day.

Proactive Auditing: Flag discrepancies in job statuses, technician assignments, or missing information before they impact downstream reporting.

Note: This data feeds every major company report, so accuracy and timeliness are critical parts of this role.

5. Cross-Department Coordination

Team Collaboration: Work daily alongside our Customer Service Representatives (CSRs), Operations, and Appointment Setting teams.

Feedback Loop: Partner with technicians on their job tracking and necessary follow-ups.

Eyes & Ears on the Ground: Flag technician performance trends, scheduling conflicts, or process gaps directly to the Operations Manager.



What We Are Looking For

Preferred Requirements:

Experience: Previous background in dispatch, scheduling, a call center, or another fast-paced, field-facing coordination role.

Multi-tasking Maestro: A strong multi-tasker who stays calm, cool, and organized when the schedule changes rapidly.

Communication Skills: Clear, friendly, and professional communicator who is equally comfortable talking to a technician in the field as they are with a customer on the phone.

Phone Stamina: Comfortable being on the phone and text/chat platforms for the majority of the workday.

Tech-Savvy: Basic comfort with spreadsheets and CRM tools, with a strong willingness to master our core tech stack (Workiz, Google Sheets, Google Chat).

Problem-Solver: An independent thinker who can make reasonable calls on reroutes and reschedules without needing every minor decision escalated.



Bonus Points (Optional):

Experience in home services, field services, or the trades (HVAC, plumbing, garage doors, electrical, etc.).

Familiarity with Workiz or similar field service management software.

Experience dispatching across multiple markets, time zones, or regions.





To Apply: 



Include on your proposal your; 

- Years of experience in Dispatch and Customer Service 

- If you have any experience working in a home improvement industry such as HVAC, Garage Door, Plumbing, etc. 

- A vocaroo recording of a short introduction about yourself 



Failure to comply will disregard your application.

title: UK Public Sector Bid Writer & Tender Manager
description:
UK PUBLIC SECTOR BID WRITER & TENDER MANAGER



Remote | Part-Time (up to 20 hrs/week) | Hybrid Pay + Uncapped Rev Share



Pay Structure — Read This First

Before you read anything else, understand how this role pays. It's built for genuine specialists who want real upside, not for generalists looking for stable hourly work.



- Base pay: $8 USD per hour, up to 20 hours per week (about $640/month).

- Rev share: 5% of first year's revenue on every UK public sector contract you write that we win. No cap. Paid as we invoice.

- Instant win bonus: $500 USD paid the day a contract is awarded, before we've invoiced anything.

- Big win bonus: £2,000 GBP additional bonus for any single contract worth £250,000 or more.



Framework panel bonus: £3,000 GBP paid the day JKN is confirmed on any framework panel worth £5M+ in total value. Paid regardless of whether call-offs land later.

What that means in real numbers



- Win a £50,000 contract: $500 instant + £2,500 rev share = £2,900+ total

- Win a £150,000 contract: $500 instant + £7,500 rev share = £7,900+ total

- Win a £250,000+ contract: $500 instant + £2,000 big-win bonus + £12,500+ rev share = £15,000+ total

- Get JKN onto a £10M framework panel: £3,000 panel bonus + ongoing rev share on call-off contracts for the framework life (3-4 years). Typically £5,000-£25,000+ total over framework life



Win a framework worth £500,000 in year one: $500 instant + £3,000 framework bonus + £25,000 rev share = £28,000+ total (about $35,000

EARNINGS OUTLOOK If you're good at this and we work together for a year, you should earn between $20,000 and $50,000 USD. That's what this role is designed to deliver for the right person.



About JKN Digital



We are JKN Digital Limited, an established UK large format print and signage company based in the North of England. Founded in 1988. We currently print for multi-site retail, hospitality, and brand clients across the UK, including some of the biggest names in British business.

We're now entering the UK public sector market. Local councils, NHS trusts, universities, housing associations, and central government departments all spend millions every year on printed signage, wayfinding, POS, banners, and vehicle graphics. That's where you come in.

We already have the operational capability, the case studies, the credentials, and the samples. What we don't have is a specialist who lives and breathes UK public procurement. That's the role.



What You'll Do



- You will run our end-to-end UK public sector tendering process:

- Monitor UK tender portals daily for opportunities matching our capability.

- Filter opportunities and present a weekly shortlist of "worth bidding" tenders with clear reasoning.

- Write full bid responses end-to-end: technical, quality, social value, executive summaries.

- Manage the entire submission process on each portal, including uploads, forms, clarifications, and hitting deadlines.

- Chase post-tender debriefs on every loss and feed lessons back into future bids.

- Build and maintain our bid library, evidence files, and case studies.

- Report weekly on pipeline, submissions, wins, losses, and what we should do next.



You are the specialist. We defer to you on public sector strategy. We give you the raw materials and the sign-off. You run the process.



Our Target Contract Zone

Focus your effort where JKN can genuinely win. Not the tiny contracts, not the giant ones.



- Primary target: individual contracts between £250,000 and £1,000,000. This is JKN's sweet spot on financial covenants, operational scale, and competitive positioning.



- Highest priority: framework agreements worth £5M+ total (across all appointed suppliers). Getting JKN onto framework panels is the single most valuable outcome of your work. Framework panels generate call-off contracts for 3-4 years without further competitive bidding.



- Secondary target: multi-lot contracts with smaller lots (sub-£1M) that JKN can bid on individually.



- Do not bid on: single contracts under £50k (not worth the effort), single contracts over £2M (JKN's scale doesn't credibly compete), or specifications that are clearly written for a specific incumbent supplier.



Mandatory Experience



Read this carefully. Applications missing any of the following will be rejected without review.



- Minimum 3 years' professional experience writing UK public sector bids. Non-UK public sector experience does not qualify. Private sector bids do not qualify.



- Direct hands-on experience with at least 5 of these portals: Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, YORtender, The Chest, NEPO, Proactis, Delta eSourcing, In-Tend, ProContract, NHS Sourcing Platform.



- Fluent, native-standard written English at UK public sector formal register. Your writing must be indistinguishable from a UK-born writer's.



Working knowledge of UK procurement terminology: PQQ, ITT, SQ, DPS, framework agreement, sub-lot, call-off, mini-competition, PPN 06/20 social value, TOMs (Themes, Outcomes, Measures), Public Contracts Regulations, MEAT scoring.

Proof of Past Wins — Verifiable, No Exceptions

You must provide evidence of at least 3 UK public sector contracts you have personally written and won for previous clients or employers. For each, we require:



1.Winning company name (yours or the client's)



2. Contracting authority (specific council, NHS trust, university, etc.)



3. Approximate contract value



4. Year of award



Plus ONE of these three as proof for each contract:



- Copy of the award letter or contract notice from the contracting authority (redact commercial confidentiality only).



- Written reference from the winning company we can contact to verify.



- Public link to the tender award notice on Find a Tender or Contracts Finder that we can independently verify.

NO EXCEPTIONS "Confidential, cannot share" is not acceptable. We understand commercial confidentiality, but at least one verifiable case is a hard requirement. If you can't prove what you've done, this role isn't for you.

Desirable (Nice to Have)



- Bid writing for print, signage, graphics, or facilities management specifically.



- Framework and DPS applications, including Crown Commercial Service frameworks.



- Experience with G-Cloud or other national procurement frameworks.



What We Provide



- Full access to JKN's UK company documentation: financials, ISO evidence, insurance certificates, environmental and safety policies, case studies, portfolio, and physical samples.



- Direct access to the owner (Wilko) and sales manager (Hassan) for factual questions and bid sign-off.



- A JKN Digital
 address so you represent us professionally.



- Payment in USD via Wise or Payoneer.



- A partner-style working relationship, not agency churn.



How We Work



- Up to 20 hours per week, flexible schedule.



- Minimum 4-hour daily overlap with UK working hours (9am to 5pm GMT/BST).



- 2-hour response window during your working hours.



- Weekly video sync with Wilko or Hassan.



Application Requirements



5. Applications missing any of the following will be rejected without review. Do not send partial applications.



6. Your CV with dates, employers, and specific detail on UK public sector bid writing experience.



7. Your list of 3+ verifiable UK public sector wins (as described above).



8. Names and current work
s of 2 UK-based references we can contact (managers, clients, or contracting authority contacts).



A 400-word writing sample answering this question:



WRITING SAMPLE QUESTION "Please describe your organisation's approach to quality management on multi-site UK-wide print rollouts, including how you ensure brand consistency across

geographically dispersed sites and how you handle production issues without impacting client deadlines. Structure your answer for a formal UK public sector bid response. 400 words maximum."



9. Do not use AI to write this. We run every sample through GPTZero and Originality.ai. AI-detected writing means immediate rejection.



Written confirmation that you accept the hybrid pay structure, 20 hours per week availability, 4-hour daily UK overlap, and 2-hour response window.



Assessment Process



10. Application review (5 days): We check your application against the mandatory requirements. Missing anything means rejection.



11. Reference calls (3 days): We contact your 2 UK references before proceeding.



12. Independent verification (3 days): We verify at least one of your named past wins independently.



13. Paid trial task (5 days): We pay you $75 USD to complete a real 3-hour task: assess a live UK tender we choose, write a bid/no-bid recommendation with reasoning, and draft a 500-word technical response for that specific tender. This is where we see your actual work.



14. Video interview (1 day): 45 minutes with Wilko. Discussion of past wins, approach, and how we'll work together.



15. Contract offer: 30-day trial period at full pay structure. Rev share applies to any contract won during the trial.

Who Shouldn't Apply



You've never written a UK public sector bid but are willing to learn. This is a specialist role, not a training opportunity.



You've written private sector bids only. Public sector is a completely different discipline.



You can't verify your past wins. We won't accept "trust me."



You use AI or ChatGPT to write bid responses.



You want stable salaried work with no volatility. This role has modest base pay and high upside by design.



Why This Role, Why Now



You've probably worked at a UK bid consultancy or as a subcontractor to one. You've written winning bids that other people got credit for. You've watched account managers collect commissions on deals you won for them.

This role is different. Your name goes on the win. Your rev share reflects the value you create. And if we grow this pipeline together, you grow with it.



We're not looking for cheap labour. We're looking for a partner who wants to build something over the next few years.



How to Apply



Send everything in one
 to [YOUR
 ADDRESS].

Subject line: UK Bid Writer Application – [YOUR FULL NAME]

We respond to all complete applications within 5 working days. Applications close [30 days from posting].



End of job specification



P.S - I am more than happy to sign an NDA if you need me to do this, so you are able to send me proof of contract previously won with other companies.

description:
Content Strategist — Personal Brands (Remote, Full-Time)



We're a creator management agency. We build personal brands for independent creators, and content is the engine behind all of it.



This role owns the engine. You d
 what gets made, you brief it, and you make sure what comes back is actually good.



What you'll do





D
 what gets made. Concepts, formats, hooks, series, angles. You're the person creators come to when they don't know what to shoot — and you always have an answer.

Write the briefs. Turn an idea into instructions a creator can execute without asking a single follow-up question: the setup, the wardrobe, the first two seconds, the feeling it needs to land. Vague briefs produce mediocre content. Yours won't be vague.

Own the pipeline. Know at any 
nt what content we have, what's running low, what's already been used, what's coming. Nobody should ever have to ask you "do we have enough" — you flagged it a week ago.

Organized to the point of being annoying about it. Nothing gets lost, nothing runs out, nothing surprises you.

Speed. High volume, multiple creators, short cycles.

Someone who only wants to be the "ideas person." Half of this job is follow-through.

Anyone whose plan is to run it all through AI. We use AI too — as a tool, not as a brain. We can tell.

A supportive team environment

This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. 



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)

If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:

Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” 

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.



1. In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” 



2. Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



3. Link the Google Doc here (view access).

Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

* Creates meaningful engagement

* Encourages conversations in the DMs

* Generates leads for free resources and offers

* Create content that balances storytelling, expertise, and practical value

* Suggest content ideas aligned with business goals

* Track content performance and identify winning themes

You may be a great fit if you:



* Have proven experience writing LinkedIn content

* Understand personal branding and thought leadership

* Know how to write content that drives conversations, not just likes

* Understand B2B marketing and client acquisition

* Can capture a founder's voice and write authentically

* Have strong research skills

* Are proactive and detail-oriented

* Can work independently and meet deadlines

* Experience in B2B lead generation

* Familiarity with LinkedIn growth strategies

* Experience turning content into qualified discovery calls



**To Apply**

3. Results you've helped achieve (engagement, leads, growth, appointments, etc.)

title: Social Media Manager
description:
ABOUT BIGGER THAN CULTURE



Bigger Than Culture is a London-based debate media brand. We run Hearts & Minds — a live, ticketed debate series — and produce short-form debate content built for social. Our defining principle is strict neutrality: we never take a side on a motion. We frame both sides fairly, put the argument in front of the audience, and let them d
.



We're building a media company, not just an events brand. Social content, live events, and community are three connected pillars — and social is the engine that drives the other two.



"Agree or disagree?" — every piece of content we publish is an invitation to the audience to make up their own mind.



THE ROLE



You will own Bigger Than Culture's entire social operation across five platforms: Instagram Reels (our lead platform), TikTok, X, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube long-form. That means running the daily publishing calendar, protecting the brand's editorial standards, managing our community, directing our virtual assistant, and reporting on what's working — with the autonomy to make calls and the judgement to flag the ones that need a founder's eye.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands debate and commentary culture, has genuinely sharp editorial instincts, and can hold a neutral line on contested topics without making the content boring.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Content & Publishing

- Run the publishing calendar: three posts daily on Instagram, with native Hearts & Minds content going out twice weekly (Wednesday and Sunday, 7pm UK).

- Mirror Instagram content to X within one hour of posting — native uploads only, never watermarked shares. Manage native distribution to TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

- Oversee YouTube long-form: 10-minute debate segments cut from Hearts & Minds events.

- Write captions to house rules: forward-looking framing, no promotion of past events, maximum five hashtags always including #BiggerThanCulture.

- Source and clip external debate content, crediting original creators in the caption.



Editorial Standards & Brand Protection

- Hold the neutrality line in every caption, comment, and reply — the brand never takes a side on a motion, ever.

- Ensure every motion statement is grounded in what the speaker actually argued — verified against captions or audio, never inferred or assumed.

- Keep visual output on-brand: the dark, premium, editorial aesthetic and the BTC video template are non-negotiable.



Community & Moderation

- Own comment and DM strategy across platforms, driving debate in the comments without steering it.

- Repost audience reactions and event content to Stories; engage with the wider debate content ecosystem from the brand account.

- Set and enforce moderation thresholds; know when to delete, when to let an argument run, and when to escalate.



Team & Process

- Manage and brief our virtual assistant: posting schedules, response protocols, and the AI prompt library for comments and DMs.

- Own the scheduling tools and content folder system so nothing goes out late and nothing goes out wrong.



Live Events

- Plan and direct content capture at Hearts & Minds events — knowing before doors open which 
nts you need and how they'll be cut.

- Drive ticket sales for upcoming events through the content calendar.



Performance

- Deliver a weekly performance report against agreed KPIs: growth, reach, engagement, and ticket conversion.

- Scout trends in debate, commentary, and culture content — and turn them into formats before they peak.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential

- Proven track record growing a brand or creator account on Instagram Reels and TikTok.

- Sharp editorial judgement on contested, culturally sensitive topics — and the discipline to stay neutral on them.

- Strong short-form copywriting; captions that spark comment-section debate.

- Experience managing a content calendar and briefing others (VA, editors, or freelancers).

- Fluent in analytics across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

- Available for evening event coverage in London.



Nice to Have

- Video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) and an eye for hook-first clip structure.

- Background in debate, journalism, politics, or commentary media.

- Experience with community moderation at scale.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted workflows for community management.

- Live events or ticketing experience (Eventbrite, Posh).

title: Paid Ads Specialist — Google, Local Service Ads & Meta Ads
description:
Exponential Oaks is a web development and design agency based in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, serving home service contractors — HVAC, plumbing, electricians, and home remodeling companies. We build custom websites and run their marketing so they can focus on the work, not chasing leads.



We're hiring a Paid Ads Specialist to manage Local Service Ads, Google Ads, and
/Instagram Ads across multiple contractor clients, and to run paid ads for Exponential Oaks itself so we can grow our own client base. This is a true dual role — you'll be treating our agency as one of your accounts, not a side task.



What You'll Do:



For clients (~80%):

-Set up and optimize Local Service Ads for home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling)

-Manage Google Ads search campaigns across multiple client accounts simultaneously — keyword research, ad copy, bid management

-Build and run
 & Instagram ad campaigns — both prospecting (before/after project photos, brand awareness) and retargeting for higher-ticket clients like remodeling and additions

-Track and report on cost-per-lead, conversion rates, and ROI monthly, per client, per platform



For Exponential Oaks (~20%):

-Run Google Search Ads targeting contractors actively looking for a web/marketing partner

-Run
 & Instagram ads and retargeting on our own site for visitors who don't convert on the first visit

-Report on our own campaign performance with the same rigor as client accounts



What We're Looking For

-Proven experience managing LSA, Google Ads, and
/Instagram Ads — please include screenshots or a portfolio of past campaigns across at least two of these platforms (no exceptions, this is how we filter applications)

-Agency experience strongly preferred — you've managed ads for multiple clients at once, not just a single in-house brand, and you understand how to juggle different accounts, budgets, and reporting cadences

-Experience with home services, local business, or lead-gen campaigns preferred (not required)

-Comfortable creating or directing simple ad creative for Meta campaigns (photos, before/after content, basic copy) — you don't need to be a designer, but you should know what converts

-Strong written English for client-facing reporting

-Comfortable working US business hours overlap (at least a few hours daily)

-Google Ads and/or Meta Blueprint certification is a plus, not required



How to Apply

Send us:



A short intro (2–3 sentences) on your Google/Meta Ads experience — please note if this was in-house or agency-side, and how many client accounts you managed at once

Screenshots or a link to 1–2 campaigns you've managed across Google and/or Meta (results, not just setup)

Your availability and expected monthly rate



Applications without campaign proof will not be considered.

Next Step

Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid test task — auditing a sample LSA or Meta account and providing recommendations — before we finalize the hire.
